title: Warehouse Associate - Part Time
description_html:
Warehouse Associate

Location: Hoxton (E2)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Hoxton team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

  • Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

  • Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

  • Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

  • A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

  • A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

  • Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

Our Interview Process

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

Overview

We're looking for an exceptional lawyer to join Omnea's growing Legal team and take real ownership across our commercial, corporate and compliance work as we rapidly scale!

Reporting to our Head of Legal, you'll be the second lawyer in the team and a trusted advisor across the business, leading commercial negotiations, advising on product and data protection, supporting corporate transactions, and helping drive our compliance and infosec agenda. You'll have a broad remit and significant autonomy to shape how Legal supports Omnea's growth into multiple markets.

You’ll be joining us at an incredibly exciting time, just as things are starting to really scale rapidly. We're looking for someone great as we work to make Omnea one of the world’s leading tech businesses: come build with us!

NB. We're either hiring this role in the UK or the US, so whilst we have an advert open for each location, we have one open headcount.

What you can expect

You’ll do whatever it takes to make sure Omnea can continue to operate at pace. You'll;

  • Review, draft, and negotiate commercial agreements with enterprise clients, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)

  • Collaborate with the enterprise sales and customer success teams to identify legal roadblocks and negotiate favorable terms that drive deal closure without compromising risk management

  • Manage high-volume enterprise contract workflows, providing triage to help sales teams prioritise negotiations and unblock deals

  • Develop and maintain playbooks and fallback positions for common enterprise negotiation scenarios, enabling faster deal cycles as the business scales

  • Partner with teams like product, engineering, and security to advise on legal and compliance implications of new features, particularly around data handling, AI capabilities, and user privacy

  • Conduct legal reviews on product releases to ensure alignment with evolving data privacy regulations and contractual commitments to customers

  • Support the product team in developing compliance documentation, feature specifications, and AI policies that can be confidently represented to enterprise prospects

  • Support on corporate and strategic projects, including fundraising and international expansion

About you

We're looking for someone commercial, capable and ready to operate with real independence:

  • You're a qualified solicitor with relevant training from a top law firm, and a minimum of 3 years' PQE (we're open on level, more experienced applicants welcome too)

  • You're a seasoned commercial operator with proven expertise negotiating and closing complex, high-volume SaaS agreements with enterprise clients.

  • You have demonstrable experience with data privacy and international compliance frameworks (GDPR, SCCs, DPAs). You can advise confidently on complex cross-border data transfer and regulatory issues

  • You thrive in fast-moving environments and can manage competing priorities at scale. You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgment calls under pressure

  • You're genuinely interested in how AI and legal tech can transform how legal works, contract automation, legal ops efficiency, process redesign and you're willing to drive adoption and experimentation

  • Your judgment can be relied upon not just on legal matters but on commercial strategy. You communicate complex issues clearly to leadership, and customers

  • You can manage large portfolios of concurrent negotiations, multiple stakeholders, and shifting priorities while maintaining excellence and attention to detail

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Email Marketing Executive
description_html:
About 1st Formations

At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence.

Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling.

We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience.

No stitched-together services.
No legacy workflows disguised as software.

Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence.

Why Join Us Now?

You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression.

  • £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR

  • Over 1 million companies formed

  • Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business

  • Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years

The Role

The Email Marketing Executive supports the Head of CRM & Lifecycle Marketing in delivering retention and engagement activity across 1st Formations’ client base of hundreds of thousands of customers. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role suited to someone early in their CRM or lifecycle marketing career who wants to build deep, practical expertise in campaign execution, segmentation and reporting within a fast-growing, data-driven marketing function.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Build, schedule and QA automated email journeys and triggered campaigns within the CRM platform (e.g. HubSpot), under the direction of the Head of CRM & Lifecycle Marketing

  1. Support the ongoing maintenance and accuracy of client segmentation and list hygiene, ensuring campaigns reach the right audience

  1. Assist with the design and set-up of A/B and multivariate tests across messaging, timing and subject lines, and help compile results

  1. Pull and organise campaign performance data, producing regular reporting packs on open, click, conversion and churn-related metrics

  1. Coordinate with design and copy resources to ensure campaign assets are delivered on time and to brand standard

  1. Monitor day-to-day campaign performance and flag anomalies, deliverability issues or underperforming journeys to the Senior Manager

  1. Maintain up-to-date documentation of live journeys, workflows and segmentation logic

  1. Support the wider Marketing team with ad hoc administrative and campaign coordination tasks as required

  1. Help ensure all client communications comply with GDPR and relevant marketing regulations

What we are looking for

  1. Some hands-on experience with a CRM or email marketing platform (e.g. HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo or similar), gained through a role, placement or personal project. Familiarity with HubSpot specifically is preferred.

  1. Strong attention to detail, particularly when building or QAing campaigns before they go live

  1. Comfortable working with data in spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets), including basic formulas and pivot tables

  1. Good written communication skills, with an ability to proofread and adapt copy for different audiences

  1. A proactive, organised approach and the ability to manage several campaigns or tasks in parallel

  1. An interest in customer retention, lifecycle marketing or CRM as a long-term career path

  1. Previous experience in a marketing assistant, coordinator or executive role, ideally in a subscription, SaaS or high-volume consumer business

  1. Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for email template edits

  1. Exposure to SQL or a willingness to learn

  1. Awareness of GDPR and email marketing compliance principles

What We Offer

  • £35-38k and comprehensive benefits package

  • Hybrid Role – 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

  • Real opportunities for progression as the business scales

  • The chance to influence both customer experience and product development

  • A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Equal Opportunities
1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Compensation: £35K – £38K • £3K Bonus

description_html:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Our current Engineering Manager holds the full picture across Channels, Analytics, Agents, and Integrations, and that context is bottlenecked in one person. We're scaling fast (Order Protection, Social Agent, Voice, and Shopping Agent are all spinning up in parallel), and the team is distributed across timezones our Engineering Manager can't fully reach.

This role closes that gap: you own engineering execution day to day, roughly 30% of what our Engineering Manager currently holds, so they can focus on strategy, customers, fundraising, and what's next. It's not a coordinator role. You run 1:1s, keep cycle cadence honest, write technical debt plans alongside engineers, and unblock people before problems become escalations. Scope changes and anything that reshapes the team are joint calls; everything else is yours.

What You'll Do

  • Delivery (~50%): Own the weekly cadence for Channels and Analytics, surface and sequence priorities with PMs and engineering leadership, unblock engineers proactively, and write technical debt plans with engineers, not for them

  • Developer Experience (~25%): Improve the things that slow good engineers down, bring structure where it adds speed, and resist adding process for its own sake

  • People Development (~25%): Run 1:1s that leave engineers with clearer thinking, deliver hard feedback directly, help senior engineers grow toward management, and act as a backup hiring partner

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

  • 3+ years managing a team of engineers in a product-delivery capacity: you've owned outcomes, not just people

  • Startup or scale-up experience: you know what it feels like when there's no process and no safety net, you've built from 0-1

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • Worked without a dedicated TPM or staff engineer as a crutch

  • Experience managing senior engineers who need a thought partner, not a process owner

Not a Fit If

  • You're in a fully hands-of managerial role

  • You need a fully defined process to operate

  • You want to redesign the org or introduce career ladders before shipping anything

  • Your primary achievement track is headcount growth or reporting lines rather than what actually shipped

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

description_html:
Role Profile

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

 

About the Infrastructure Team

The Infrastructure Team spearheads the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of critical HPC/AI infrastructure to the broader Technology and Customer organizations. Its mission is to deploy scalable, secure, and efficient infrastructure solutions tailored to the organization's strategic needs. The team defines Radiant's supercomputers' reference architecture in line with the customer, software, and operational requirements of the company.

They work closely with third-party suppliers to provide and maintain the list of technologies that form part of Radiant's portfolio of offerings. Because that portfolio is built almost entirely on external capacity — GPU cloud providers, OEMs, colocation and datacenter partners, networking and storage vendors — the strength of Radiant's supplier relationships is inseparable from the strength of its platform.

 

Vendor management sits at the centre of that. The Vendor Manager owns how suppliers enter Radiant's ecosystem, what commercial terms we hold them to, and whether they perform against those terms once deployed. They partner with the broader Radiant team to turn a fragmented supplier base into a governed, tiered portfolio the delivery teams can rely on.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own the vendor onboarding process end to end, taking new suppliers through a tiered model that matches the depth of diligence to the depth of the relationship:

    • Known vendor: transactional suppliers. Entity and sanctions screening, financial viability, security questionnaire, standard terms, payment setup.

    • Partner: recurring or material spend. Deeper due diligence, named commercial and technical owners on both sides, negotiated terms, defined SLAs, and an agreed review cadence.

    • Strategic partner: suppliers Radiant depends on for capacity, continuity, or roadmap. Executive sponsorship, joint QBRs, capacity and roadmap alignment, exit and continuity planning, and concentration-risk review.

  • Run intake triage for new supplier requests: assign the right tier, drive the diligence to completion, and keep the pipeline moving so delivery teams are not blocked waiting on process.

  • Maintain a single source of truth for every infrastructure and compute contract — terms, renewal and notice dates, committed spend, reserved capacity, price escalators, and termination rights.

  • Run renewals on a forward calendar rather than as a fire drill, flagging every material renewal ahead of its notice window with a recommendation to renew, renegotiate, or exit, backed by usage data.

  • Ensure compliance requirements flow into commercial terms before and during negotiations

  • Track consumption against commitments and flag under-utilised reservations or approaching overage before they hit the budget, feeding real usage patterns back into the next negotiation.

  • Define and report the KPIs and SLAs that matter, such as allocation against reservation, incident frequency, provisioning lead times, support responsiveness, and invoice accuracy.

  • Run the vendor review cadence: monthly or quarterly reviews for partners, and QBRs with executive attendance for strategic partners.

  • Own escalation and remediation when a vendor underperforms — raise it, document it, agree a corrective action plan, and pursue service credits where they are earned.

  • Establish vendor incident notification requirements & playbooks (timeframe, escalation, documentation) for breach response and incident communication.

  • Maintain a vendor scorecard that Infrastructure leadership can read in five minutes and take to the executive team.

  • Own third-party risk assessment and periodic re-assessment across security, data protection, financial, and geographic or concentration risk, in partnership with Security and Legal.

  • Keep certifications, insurance, and data-protection documentation current (SOC 2, ISO 27001, DPAs, sub-processor disclosures), and support internal and customer audits with clean, retrievable vendor records.

  • Maintain continuity and exit plans for single-source dependencies, so that for any critical supplier Radiant knows what the fallback is and roughly what switching would cost in time and money.

  • Support the establishment of vendor management best practices and continuously improve the process, templates, and documentation through the participation of "lessons learned" workshops.

 

Requirements

  • BSc in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years in vendor management, IT procurement, strategic sourcing, or supplier operations, with meaningful time spent on technology and infrastructure categories.

  • Demonstrated experience managing infrastructure and compute suppliers, such as GPU providers, OEMs, networking or storage vendors.

  • Proven track record negotiating and managing complex technology contracts, including MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, SLAs, and multi-year committed-spend agreements.

  • Fluency with the commercial mechanics of compute: committed use and reserved capacity, rate cards, burst and overage pricing, egress and transfer costs, SLA credit structures, renewal escalators, and liability caps.

  • Sufficient technical literacy to hold a credible conversation with infrastructure engineers about GPU, networking, and storage, and to distinguish a genuine capacity constraint from a negotiating position.

  • Experience designing and operating vendor governance frameworks — tiering, onboarding, due diligence, performance scorecards, and third-party risk assessment.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a track record interfacing with various types of stakeholders (engineering/operations teams, vendors, legal, finance) and writing clear deliverables.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, high-complexity technical environments, and building process where none currently exists.

 

Nice to have

  • Prior work experience in HPC, hyperscale, Telco, or AI infrastructure environments involving large-scale compute procurement.

  • Working knowledge of the GPU and AI hardware vendor landscape (NVIDIA and its OEM channel, alternative accelerator vendors, neocloud providers) and how their allocation models and roadmaps work in practice.

  • Understanding of datacenter commercial models, including colocation agreements, power contracts, and capacity reservation structures.

  • Familiarity with vendor management or contract lifecycle management (CLM) tooling, and with procurement workflows in ERP systems.

  • Exposure to export controls, sanctions screening, or hardware supply-chain constraints affecting GPU and networking availability.

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the third-party risk side.

  • A professional procurement or contract management qualification (CIPS, WorldCC, or equivalent).

description_html:
Job Title: People Operations

Reports to: People Manager

Location: London onsite

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure, from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one, who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the role

We are hiring a People Operations Specialist to run the employee lifecycle at Radiant and to keep making it better as we grow.

We're looking for someone who loves building automations, agents and workflows, and wants to point that instinct at People Ops. You'll own the data and systems behind our People Ops stack (HiBob, Ashby, Notion), and use that ownership as the foundation for turning slow, manual, multi-tool processes into things that mostly run themselves. This is a role for someone who'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month planning the perfect system - someone who gets a genuine kick out of making the unglamorous stuff disappear. You’ll bring expertise, energy, and commercial thinking to help us elevate our People processes. The challenge in this role is to put the systems and frameworks in place that let us scale that quality, consistency, and fairness as we grow – without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

What you'll do

People Operations (~80%)

  • Run new joiner onboarding end to end, but treat every manual step you touch twice as a candidate for automation, with the goal is to keep making the process faster and lighter-touch, not just execute it reliably.

  • Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc.

  • Process documentation: create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and playbooks for onboarding, offboarding, and systems admin current as processes evolve, so nothing lives only in your head.

  • Own and execute core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes and off-boarding.

  • Ensure compliance with local labour laws and internal policies across different regions.

  • Coordinate team socials, offsites, and the other moments that bring a distributed team together.

  • Liaise with our payroll providers (UK and US) to process any changes, corrections, or new starters/leavers each cycle

  • Keep policies and the employee handbook up to date and ensure compliance with any UK/US regulatory changes during the cover period

  • Translate employee feedback into concrete action points and employee journey initiatives

  • Employee first-line support: be the first point of contact for day-to-day employee questions on payroll, leave, benefits, and admin

  • Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc, that catch data errors before they become a downstream mess in payroll or compliance.

Improving it (~20%)

  • Support and contribute to improving, automating, and streamlining HR processes, with a focus on scalability and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and maintain automations, workflows, and AI agents across our People Ops tooling (HiBob, Ashby, Notion) - from a simple triggered workflow to a more sophisticated internal agent - turning multi-step manual processes into things that run themselves.

  • Contribute to and take ownership of parts of people-related projects and process improvements.

  • Turn employee feedback into specific, sequenced actions with owners and dates — not a list of themes.

  • Use data from our people systems to show where time is going, what is working, and what to fix next.

  • Keep the People pages in Notion current, and improve them as you learn where colleagues get stuck.

  • Partner with relevant stakeholders on anything touching UK employment or compliance judgement calls while you build fluency here. You own the system and the escalation path, and that ownership shifts to you over time.

What you'll bring

  • You've worked in a high-growth environment, ideally remote and across multiple geographies, and you're comfortable working async across EMEA time zones.

  • Experience building people systems in scaling companies, ideally through comparable periods of fast growth.

  • A practical, hands-on approach – comfortable building from scratch rather than inheriting an established function.

  • Strong judgement and a commercial mindset.

  • The ability to influence managers and senior leaders through credibility rather than authority.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, pace, and a deliberately low-process environment.

title: Founding Operations Engineer (Legal)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Odin
description_html:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

  • You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

  • This is a legal role with heavy operational involvement and a requirement to build things. It is not a legal counsel role. You'll be qualified, you'll be able to act as counsel on day to day deal legals, but you'll sit close to the work and focus on streamlining / automating the systems generating the work in the first place.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Microsoft Word or Docusign.

What you'll own

  • Post-close and deal legals: You’ll own post-close: governance events, transfers, secondaries, distributions and exits. There is huge surface area for automation here too. You’ll also take care of the unusual issues where our documentation doesn't cleanly answer a question.

  • Legal Reviews & Escalations: Every legal escalation coming out of the operations team.

  • Automation: You'll work alongside the deal operations team, with a standing instruction to automate their work. You'll bring product/design/engineering into the things that genuinely need significant engineering work, but you’ll mainly work autonomously without them. Before it gets to them you've already made the process as simple and fast as possible, and usually vibe coded something that works well but perhaps needs to be stabilised / scaled.

  • Managing external counsel: You’ll help decide what stays in-house, what goes out, and hold external advisers to account on cost and turnaround.

What we're looking for

  • AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

  • Qualified, with real deal legals experience: Funds, corporate, or financial services.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal?
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • Commercial judgement at speed: You're comfortable in a regulated business and comfortable with the fact that commercial and regulatory pressure sometimes point in different directions. You are able to make decisions autonomously in this environment.

  • You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You want to practise law in a firm, or you want a purely advisory seat with a wall between you and the operation;

  • You need complete information before you'll give a view;

  • You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£80k - £100k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options

  • Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total)

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

  • Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave

title: Member of Technical Staff (SWE/Product)

description_html:
About Aptura

We build the evaluation datasets and RL environments that make AI reliable in domains where mistakes are expensive: finance, healthcare, and legal. Our team designs expert-curated training data, calibrated rubrics, and verifiable task environments for AI labs and startups pushing the frontier of what models can do in regulated industries.

We're a small, lean, London based team that moves fast and takes the work seriously. Everyone contributes directly. Initiative is rewarded, and ownership is the default. If you want to shape how frontier AI learns to operate in the real world, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on our Software Engineering team, you will build the platform that powers how Aptura operates and scales — the annotation tooling, workflow systems, quality control pipelines, and internal infrastructure that sit behind every dataset and environment we ship.

Day to day, that looks like: designing expert task creation flows, building task assignment and review interfaces, writing the data pipelines that move outputs from domain experts into structured training sets, and integrating LLM-powered tooling directly into the product. Some days it's product engineering. Some days it's closer to infrastructure. The common thread is that the software you build is what lets a small team produce high-quality evaluation data at scale.

You'll be the person who makes the platform real. Decide what gets built, how it gets built, and set the standard for how we build as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the core data annotation and workflow platform end to end — from task assignment and expert interfaces to quality control and dataset delivery

  • Design systems that support expert onboarding, task routing, review workflows, and QA at scale

  • Build and improve AI-integrated pipelines across the platform, including LLM-assisted annotation, automated checking, and model-in-the-loop workflows

  • Work directly with founders and domain operators to turn manual, bespoke processes into reliable, scalable software

  • Make strong product and engineering decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations — scoping, prioritising, and shipping without waiting for perfect specs

  • Help define how we build as a team: tooling choices, engineering standards, and product direction

Who We're Looking For

You will not be a good fit if you thrive in well-defined scopes and prefer a clear spec before moving. We are looking for people who are comfortable identifying what needs building, making a call, and shipping — often before the full picture is clear.

You will not be a good fit if you like to go deep on one technical area for an extended period. We are looking for people who are energised by moving across product, infrastructure, data systems, and AI tooling — sometimes all in the same week.

You will not be a good fit if you prefer to hand work off at the boundaries of your role. We are looking for people who want to own problems end to end, from the first conversation through to something live.

You will not be a good fit if you aren't yet integrating AI into how you build day to day. We are looking for people who are already using LLMs and coding agents as part of how they work, and are excited to push that further.

You will not be a good fit if you think of speed and quality as things you trade off against each other. We are looking for people who don't cut corners — they cut scope.

We don't care about background, experience, or prestige. We want people who can demonstrate they will work hard, learn fast, and ship things that matter. Former founders, early engineers at startups, and people with infrastructure experience are a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal tools, annotation platforms, workflow software, or operations-heavy products

  • Familiarity with modern product stacks: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, FastAPI, or similar

  • Exposure to AI products, LLM tooling, or evaluation workflows

  • Domain interest in finance, healthcare, or legal

  • Previous experience as an early or founding engineer

On-site in London. Compensation (salary + equity) will be competitive.

title: Technical Project Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Certa
description_html:
Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.

What You'll Do

  • Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.

  • Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.

  • Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.

  • Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.

  • Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.

  • Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.

  • Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.

What Success Looks Like

  • On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.

  • Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.

  • Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.

  • Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.

  • Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.

  • Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).

  • Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.

  • Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.

  • Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

  • Time off: 49 days paid time off

  • Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

  • Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

  • Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

  • London

  • San Francisco

  • Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

  • Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

  • Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

  • A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

  • Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

description_html:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role

Events are one of the biggest parts of how Adclear goes to market. Our breakfasts, dinners and panels are where compliance and marketing leaders from banks, lenders and fintechs meet us, meet each other, and see what modern compliance can look like. This role owns that engine, along with the partnerships that carry our name further across the industry.

We run three events a quarter, so the cadence is high and so is the bar. You'll take each one from a blank page to a full room:

  • A theme that fits our product and positioning, and gives a senior compliance leader a real reason to give up their morning or evening.

  • Invites, graphics and social assets that you design yourself.

  • A guest list you build, invite personally and chase until every seat is filled.

  • A day that runs smoothly: venue, speakers, run of show, and every guest leaving having met someone worth knowing.

  • Follow-up that keeps the conversations from the room going long after the event.

On the partnerships side, you'll own our relationships with major compliance bodies, industry influencers and marketing institutions: the organisations and people who shape how our market thinks.

title: Paralegal

description_html:
About the Role
Reporting to the General Counsel, you'll provide core paralegal support across contracts, legal research, and company secretarial matters — while driving AI and legal tech adoption across the team. This role is built for someone genuinely fluent in AI and legal tech, not just comfortable using it: you'll be the one embedding these tools into everyday legal workflows so the team drafts, reviews, and manages documentation faster and more accurately. You'll work closely with the General Counsel, Senior Legal Counsel, and Risk & Compliance Manager.

What You'll Do

  • Champion AI-enabled legal tools across the team — identify, trial, and roll out solutions that speed up drafting, research, and review

  • Prepare and quality-check first drafts of engagement letters, NDAs, and standard contracts using AI tools, escalating anything non-standard

  • Build and maintain an AI-tagged contract and precedent library

  • Run AI-assisted legal and regulatory research, sense-checking outputs and summarising findings in plain language

  • Own adoption of legal tech platforms (CLM, e-signature, matter management, AI drafting tools) as the team's go-to for troubleshooting

  • Build lightweight automations and prompt templates to cut manual admin

  • Maintain statutory registers, company secretarial records, and board/governance documentation

  • Support client onboarding and audit/review documentation requests

What You Bring

  • Strong, demonstrable experience using AI and legal tech tools in a professional legal setting (AI drafting/review tools, legal research assistants, CLM or automation platforms) — this is a core, non-negotiable requirement, not an interest area

  • A proven track record of driving AI or legal tech adoption within a legal or compliance team

  • Confidence learning and rolling out new software fast, and comfortable training others on it

  • Paralegal qualification (e.g. CILEX) or law degree/LPC, or equivalent experience

  • 3–5 years' paralegal experience, ideally in professional services or fast-growth tech

  • Sharp drafting, research, and attention-to-detail skills, with the judgement to catch when AI gets it wrong

  • Highly organised and comfortable in a flat, collaborative team

About Unity Advisory
Built for the AI-enabled world, we run a lean, conflict-free, client-centric model that embeds AI across all workstreams. No audit practice means no audit-related conflicts — just a flat, collaborative team focused on outcomes for clients.

title: Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Healf
description_html:
Healf is Europe's fastest-growing company.

Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.

The next chapter is harder and more interesting.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.

We’re looking for a high-agency Product Designer to take our web experience to the next level. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of how consumers discover and engage with curated, personalised wellbeing at scale.

You’ll be joining a high-performing product and engineering team improving product discovery, reducing friction and boosting conversion across the full user journey- from collection and PDP pages to our quiz and subscription portal, while ensuring the Healf experience feels personal, actionable and deeply human.

This role is ideal for someone with strong UX and UI design skills, an eye for clean, scalable UI, a sense for what drives conversion and a genuine passion for building a better experience for our users. You don’t need to have worked in wellness or FMCG but a solid foundation in eCommerce, CRO and design systems is key.

We’re looking for a designer that embraces AI in their processes from research through to prototyping. We’re interested in the outcomes you’ve actually affected, not the arbitrary use of AI to tick a box or impress a stakeholder.

What you’ll own

  • Lead UX/UI work across core surfaces of the Healf website

  • AI tooling for the e-com product design team, working closely with developers to build systems and workflows that take design from concept to production ready code.

  • Design systems and unification of components across platforms

  • Design personalised experiences that help users find what they need (and didn’t know they needed) faster.

  • Develop creative solutions to reduce friction and drive conversion

  • Collaborate with product, content, and engineering to ensure fast, high-quality execution

  • Play a key role in evolving our cross-platform design system to support consistent growth

  • Conduct user research and experimentation to validate and refine design decisions

  • Set a high bar for craft, detail, and performance in everything we ship

You might be a fit if you

  • Bring experience of designing products in eCommerce, DTC, consumer tech, or health & wellbeing

  • Know how to turn messy, ambiguous problems into elegant, usable experiences

  • Have a sharp eye for layout, hierarchy, and UX clarity- and understand what converts

  • Are confident owning UX/UI end to end, from whiteboard to final polish

  • Are familiar with CRO practices and improving performance across conversion funnels

  • Have experience working with (or contributing to) design systems in Figma

  • Collaborate well with engineers and can speak dev-friendly language when needed

  • Are proactive, independent and excited to take ownership of large surfaces

  • Are energised by building new things that help people live healthier, better lives

The Deal

We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.

In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade.

We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company.

If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it.

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

About the Role

Taptap Send is building a new institutional payments business. We move money across 80+ emerging market corridors and are now opening that infrastructure to institutional clients — crypto exchanges, fintechs, MTOs, and corporate treasury teams. This is an early commercial hire into that business.

The Role

You'll own a pipeline of institutional partners from first contact through to live. You'll work closely with trading and ops to structure deals and get clients across the line quickly.

What You'll Do

  • Comfortable selling a technical product to sophisticated buyers, treasury teams, CFOs, heads of payments

  • Organised, self-directed, and happy working without a large support structure around you

What We Offer

  • Direct line to senior leadership and real influence over commercial strategy

  • A fast-growing platform with genuine EM depth and strong banking infrastructure behind it

Job Title: Director of Trading

The Director of Trading will own and run Taptap Send's FX trading function across its emerging-market corridors, G10 treasury book, as well as stablecoinon/off ramp.   • Trading Execution: Own day-to-day FX execution across 40+ actively traded currencies, setting the standard for execution quality, pricing and risk discipline.

We're building cutting-edge LLM-powered tools that supercharge investment research for the world's most demanding deal teams. Our clients include several of the top 10 global private equity firms, Big 4 professional services firms, and leading consulting practices: organisations responsible for deploying billions of dollars annually.

We're profitable, bootstrapped, and past $20M in revenue after growing 10x in 2025. We're on track for 2–3x growth this year, and our product saves clients an average of 30 hours per week. We're expanding fast into investment banking, hedge funds, and research firms. Our PM team is currently 2 strong - we're looking for PMs #3-6 to own the core research workflow and help build out the product org as we scale from 60 to 120 people.

 

💡 The role

You'll own the core research workflow end to end - problem discovery, MVP scoping, shipping, and driving adoption. You'll run the day-to-day execution loop: partnering with engineering and design on specs and tradeoffs, talking to customers (PE firms, consultancies) on regular calls to understand their workflows and priorities, driving QA and release readiness, and keeping founders and leadership aligned with lightweight, high-signal communication.

You ship frequently - we measure success by shipping 1 major feature per week and driving measurable adoption of everything that ships. This is a high-ownership IC role; as the org grows, you'll have the opportunity to transition into a leadership role.

 

✅ What you'll do

  • Own the roadmap and execution for the core research workflow

  • Join customer calls with CS and users weekly; understand their workflows, pain points, and what "great" looks like

  • Partner with engineering + design to prioritize, scope, and ship quickly - your bar is MVP done, not perfect

  • Drive QA and launch readiness: testing plans, bug triage, launch checklists, iteration plans

  • Keep stakeholders (founders, engineering, design, CS) aligned through direct conversation, not documents

  • Demo new features on sales and CS calls; translate customer feedback into product priorities immediately

title: Staff Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fonoa
description_html:
At Fonoa, we are transforming how digital-first companies stay tax compliant. We provide simple and modular API solutions that easily integrate into any existing workflow. Through our technology-first approach, we reduce manual processes, increase compliance and reduce the cost of operations when transacting and scaling internationally.

We are solving one of the largest yet unsolved problems in global e-commerce. Our tax automation software enables companies such as Uber, Zoom & Booking.com to expand their international offerings more quickly and remain tax-compliant.

Role Description

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of Fonoa's AI-native Tax Operating System. You'll design new AI-powered products and experiences, simplify complex tax workflows, and help define the future of our platform.

You'll join an independent Design organization, working alongside a high-caliber team of designers, product managers, engineers, and tax managers. As one of our senior individual contributors, you'll have the opportunity to shape our products, influence a brand new design system from the ground up, and raise the quality bar across everything we build.

This is a hands-on Staff IC role reporting to the Head of Design, with a strong focus on systems thinking, craft, and execution.

What you'll do

  • Shape the next generation of Fonoa. Design new AI-powered products and experiences that become core parts of our Tax Operating System.

  • Own products end to end. Lead the design process from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, prototyping, and launch.

  • Simplify complexity. Turn sophisticated tax, regulatory, and AI workflows into intuitive experiences that customers trust.

  • Think in systems. Design scalable foundations, contribute to our new design system, and create patterns that enable future products.

  • Partner across disciplines. Work closely with Product, Engineering, AI, Tax, and User Research to shape product direction, not just execute requirements.

  • Raise the quality bar. Champion exceptional craft, attention to detail, and thoughtful execution across everything we build.

What we're looking for

  • Exceptional product craft. You care deeply about interaction design, visual quality, motion, and the details that make products feel effortless.

  • Strong systems thinking. You can design both individual experiences and the larger product architecture behind them.

  • Experience building design systems. You've created or significantly evolved systems that scale across products and teams.

  • Complex product experience. You've designed sophisticated B2B, enterprise, fintech, developer, or infrastructure products where simplifying complexity was central to your work.

  • AI curiosity. You're excited about designing AI-native experiences that solve real customer problems, not just adding AI for its own sake.

  • A strong portfolio. Your work demonstrates end-to-end ownership, clear thinking, and measurable impact, not just polished visuals.

  • Collaborative mindset. You communicate clearly, challenge ideas thoughtfully, and enjoy working closely with cross-functional teams.

As part of the recruitment process at Fonoa, we process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice for Job Applicants. This notice explains how and why your data is collected and used, and how you can contact us if you have any concerns.

title: ECommerce Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Luzern eCommerce Group
description_html:
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with an ambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

We are looking for a talented and conceptual Mid Weight Designer to bolster our Content team. Reporting to the Content Operations Manager, you will be responsible for supporting them with content optimisation projects, for multiple high-profile clients, across a range of marketplaces (primarily Amazon). You will also need to be comfortable managing design projects. We are looking for someone who does more than just execute briefs; we need a strategic thinker who considers how Marketplace assets function across different cultures and markets, all while maintaining brand integrity.

You will be naturally motivated and eager to learn. You'll work alongside other designers and copywriters. You'll produce assets for e-commerce, from concept through to final artwork, as well as contributing to the growth of the Luzern's Content offering. You'll be proactive and well organised, showcasing your capabilities to problem solve design issues working independently and collaboratively, while being adept at handling tight deadlines, across multiple projects, in a fast-paced start-up environment.

You will have experience in using Adobe Creative Suite and Figma to produce digital creative assets, strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as the desire to understand brands and accurately represent them on marketplaces. An interest in E-Commerce & marketplace industry trends will be beneficial.

You will be an integral part of the team, bringing new ideas and expertise that helps evolve the Content team.

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design creative assets for Amazon and other e-commerce platforms, from concept to final artwork
  • Translate client briefs into engaging, on-brand visual content
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects with tight deadlines
  • Collaborate with the Content Operations Manager and team to deliver high-quality, timely work
  • Communicate design ideas and feedback clearly to internal stakeholders and clients
  • Maintain consistency and attention to detail across all outputs
  • Proactively identify issues or dependencies and raise them early
  • Stay current with design trends, marketplace standards, and UX best practices
  • Provide feedback and guidance to junior designers or third party partners
  • Conduct or support training sessions in Adobe Creative Suite for the team
  • Define overall content strategies for our clients and provide feedback on designs and copy created

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 2 years' hands-on experience designing for Amazon (e.g. A+ content, Storefronts, PDP imagery)
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite — Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign (3+ years required)
  • Experience producing content for digital or e-commerce platforms
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, is essential
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
  • Excellent time management and prioritisation skills
  • High attention to visual detail, layout, and brand alignment
  • Proactive mindset and strong problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to work well both in a team and independently
  • Collaborative team player, yet self-sufficient in execution
  • Experience in optimizing content based on performance metrics and A/B test results
  • Knowledge of design principles, typography, and color theory

Advantages but not essential

  • Portfolio showcasing relevant Amazon and e-commerce design work
  • Amazon Content experience (1 year preferred)
  • Design related qualification
  • Experience designing with generative AI

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary package with benefits.
  • Work-Life Balance: Competitive annual leave and flexible working arrangements.
  • Growth Opportunities: Access to learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
  • Culture and Environment: A fun, inclusive, and collaborative workplace.
  • Wellbeing Support: Access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Quarterly Social Events: Company-sponsored quarterly social events designed to bring teams together, celebrate success, and strengthen connections across the business

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Working Student / Intern – Industrialization Land / UGV (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Quantum-Systems GmbH
description_html:
As a Working Student or Intern (m/f/d) in the field of Land Systems / UGV Industrialization, you will support our team in Göppingen in establishing serial production for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs). You will work closely with the Industrialization team and our external consulting partners, taking responsibility for clearly defined work packages in documentation, data management, and production planning preparation.

You will collaborate across Production, Engineering, Quality, and Logistics, gaining first-hand experience of a real production ramp-up from the very beginning and seeing how a prototype-based setup evolves into a scalable and repeatable serial production process.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Support the shopfloor planning activities at our Göppingen site by documenting current-state processes and contributing to layout planning, material flow design, and production cycle data (e.g., cycle times, workstation utilization, and walking distances).

  • Support process design activities by helping to structure and document assembly processes for different vehicle variants down to individual work-step level.

  • Create and maintain illustrated work instructions for production processes.

  • Collect, prepare, and analyze process-related data using Excel.

  • Support qualification and training activities by maintaining workstation-specific skill matrices and preparing training materials for assembly teams.

  • Prepare and follow up on workshops and alignment meetings with external consulting partners, including meeting minutes, task tracking, and status reporting.



What you bring to the team:

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Logistics, or a comparable field of study.

  • You are proficient in using Excel and PowerPoint; initial experience with CAD or layout planning tools is a plus.

  • First practical experience in manufacturing, workshop environments, or through academic projects is welcome, but not required.

  • You work accurately and reliably when creating documentation and maintaining data, including recurring tasks.

  • You have a structured and independent way of working and are willing to take ownership of your tasks and follow up on topics proactively.

  • You communicate openly and professionally and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from Production, Engineering, and external partners.

  • You are available to work regularly on-site in Göppingen; the scope and duration of your engagement can be tailored individually.

  • You have good German and English language skills.

  • You have experience using AI tools effectively.

  • You are available to start immediately or by November 1st at the latest.

Why Quantum-Systems:

Wir glauben an die Stärke kombinierter Fähigkeiten: klare technische Expertise gepaart mit einer kundenorientierten Ausrichtung. Wir sind Branchenpioniere, die ehrgeizig, mutig und visionär sind. Wir überschreiten Grenzen, blicken über den Tellerrand und streben nach technologischer Exzellenz, um die Zukunft unbemannter Systeme mitzugestalten. Wir versprechen, dass wir Deine Startbahn für individuelles und berufliches Wachstum sein werden.

Our benefits:

  • Flexible working hours: With our trust-based working time model, you have the flexibility to manage not only your working hours but also your work-life balance independently.

  • Stay active: Through the EGYM Wellpass, you gain access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities, and we subsidize your membership.

  • Corporate Benefits: Take advantage of attractive offers and discounts from well-known brands and providers such as Adidas, Apple, and Expedia.

  • Team Events: We believe in growing together and celebrating our successes as a team.

About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.
