  • Culture & Feel Good – Zusammenarbeit mitgestalten: Du bist an der Planung und Durchführung von internen und externen Events beteiligt und erstellst Konzepte, die unser Teamgefühl fördern und unsere Arbeitgebermarke stärken.



IT'S A MATCH, SOFERN DU...

  • eingeschrieben bist und dich mindestens im dritten Semester deines Studiums befindest – beispielsweise in BWL mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Personalmanagement, (Wirtschafts-)Psychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst und du dich selbst zugänglich und empathisch beschreibst.

  • sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen bist und gerne digital arbeitest.

  • sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Teamspirit, den man erlebt: Offene Zusammenarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und regelmäßige Teamevents sind bei uns fest verankert. Ob Team-Lunch, Afterwork-Drinks oder gemeinsame Aktivitäten – wir nehmen uns bewusst Zeit füreinander.

  • Unsere Werte – gelebter Alltag: Teamgeist, Professionalität und Leidenschaft prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, übernehmen Verantwortung und wachsen gemeinsam. 

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts: Unser zentral gelegenes Büro mit moderner Ausstattung bietet dir Raum für kreative Ideen, konzentriertes Arbeiten und entspanntes Abschalten.

  • Sie sind absolut vertraulich und gehen verantwortungsbewusst mit Personal- und Finanzdaten um
  • Sie sind verbindlich, freundlich und kommunizieren gut mit Kunden, Kollegen und externen Partnern

Benefits

  • Eine unbefristete Stelle mit rund 20 Wochenstunden

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung mit Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

title: Product Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wave
description_html:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year-on-year. And, we're still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people's everyday lives.

We're looking for an engineer who's independent and excited about getting things done. You'll be responsible for building and improving the ways people pay with Wave. You'll own every step of the process: from understanding the problem to shipping your solution to users to helping the customer support team resolve problems.

You'll join an autonomous, cross-functional team focused on a single area of Wave's product. Each team is led by a Product Manager and an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead. We organize projects to give you as much ownership as possible. Typically, you'll be responsible for a feature or improvement end-to-end, from design through deployment.

Our to-do list changes constantly, but here are some recent projects:

  • Enabling people to use their Wave app to pay for products in stores.
  • Allowing people to pay their electricity bills with Wave by integrating with electrical utility companies.
  • Building an app for business owners to pay their employees' salaries using Wave.
  • Allowing people to pay for their transportation on taxis, trains & buses.

Our stack:

  • backend: Python 3 (+ mypy)
  • API layer: GraphQL
  • android frontend: Kotlin/Jetpack
  • iOS frontend: Swift/SwiftUI
  • web frontend: TypeScript/React
  • database: Postgres/CockroachDB
  • infrastructure: GCP/Terraform
  • orchestration: Kubernetes

We expect all engineers to be willing to work across the entire stack, including mobile. Prior experience in these technologies is a strong plus, but not required.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso.
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $152,100 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as a product engineer.
  • Fluent in English, (bilingual in French is a big bonus!)
  • Successful candidates must be willing to travel to one of our operating locations at least once per year for a minimum of 6 consecutive days.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Reflexively ask yourself, "is this code the best way to make my users happy?"
  • Want to learn to solve hard problems and aren't afraid to ask for help when you get stuck.
  • Are excited to learn about complex systems.
  • Can communicate clearly with colleagues who work, speak and think differently.
  • Work to make things easier for the next engineer who will touch your code.
  • Always try to improve as a programmer and colleague.
  • Are excited to deeply understand the inner workings of the tools you use.

About engineering at Wave

We care about the big picture. We don't hire engineers to just ship tickets. We hire them to solve problems. That means caring deeply about outcomes, understanding context, and jumping in wherever something's broken, even if it's technically "not your area." When we see problems, inefficiencies, or opportunities to make something better, we act. We dig into operational issues, clarify fuzzy product specs, or step into unfamiliar code to help unblock teammates.

We move as fast as possible. Speed matters. It lets us try things quickly, get feedback early, and course-correct while it's cheap. So we write small PRs. We aim for MVPs. We leave TODOs and file follow-ups. We don't over-perfect v1. That said, we're building a financial product. Some things—like money movement, correctness, or security—deserve more caution.

We like boring technology. We favor tools that are reliable, well-understood, and easy to debug. This keeps us focused on solving meaningful problems instead of wrestling with unpredictable infrastructure. If a new technology helps us move faster, build safer, or solve a real need, we'll consider it. But we don't adopt tools just because they're new—we adopt them because they're right.

Simplicity is a strategy. It lets us focus our energy where it matters most: serving our users.

 

#LI-DH1 #LI-REMOTE

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Care
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deliveroo
description_html:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Care

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our London team. In this role, you'll help shape the decision-making systems that directly impact customer experience, trust, and fairness at Deliveroo. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Care team. Care is an area with significant opportunity and real customer impact; you'll take ownership of existing models and help define strong ML foundations in spaces that are still evolving, from LLM-powered automation to customer compensation logic.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: Lead the design, development, and productionisation of machine learning models used in customer support and high-stakes decision systems.

  • Architect for reliability: Build robust monitoring, evaluation, and alerting frameworks to detect model underperformance, drift, or unexpected behaviour in real-time.

  • Collaborate on product strategy: Partner closely with Product Managers to turn ambiguous customer problems into robust, scalable ML solutions.

  • Drive technical excellence: Provide technical leadership in areas with unclear ownership, setting the gold standard for ML quality, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Bridge science and engineering: Work with data scientists and engineers across the global organisation to embed models into high-performance, scalable systems.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience as an ML Engineer or Data Scientist, with a proven ability to write high-quality production code in Python.

  • Demonstrated ownership of productionising Generative AI workstreams or Agentic AI projects, including a deep understanding of LLMs, transformers, and fine-tuning.

  • Proven ability to deploy and manage models using modern infrastructure tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and CircleCI.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of traditional ML and evaluation techniques, balanced with a bias for simplicity and measurable business impact.

  • A collaborative mindset with experience mentoring peers and a drive to solve complex, real-world problems at scale.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with evaluation harnesses and frameworks specifically designed for Generative AI.

  • Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and safety techniques for deployed GenAI systems.

  • Experience working with strongly typed languages, such as Go.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

description_html:
adjoe is redefining the future of mobile ads. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data and world-class engineers, we’ve perfected the offerwall experience for monetizing and scaling app publishers with solutions like Playtime and Arcade – now the fastest growing rewarded advertising channel globally – driving incremental engagement, retention, and revenue.

At the same time, we’re breaking into programmatic advertising with the intelligent bidding system of adjoe Ads. Together, this ecosystem connects app developers to over 600 million users worldwide for scalable growth. Backed by a $100 million investment from Bertelsmann and operating from offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, adjoe is defining the next stages of app and ad experience – right now. Join us.

Where Talent Ambitions Meets Product Strategy

The Employee Experience team designs and operates the programs and initiatives that shape how people join, grow, and perform at adjoe. The full employee lifecycle, built to support a high-performance organization ready to build ad technologies that reach every user on the globe.

The work sits at the intersection of people strategy and execution. On one side, designing structured programs that raise the bar: performance frameworks, development initiatives, and the onboarding experience that sets the standard from day one. On the other, building adjoe's employer brand externally — telling our story on how we solve biggest adtech challenges.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in employer branding, specifically within the tech industry.

  • You will define and evolve our Employer Value Proposition, showcasing real employee journeys and career development paths across video, podcasts, social channels, and external platforms. We are looking for someone who loves connecting with people and bringing authentic human and tech stories to life.

  • You will build and manage an active engineering blog pipeline and tech content strategy. You will partner directly with developers, tech leads, and directors to translate complex backend systems and tech pillars into engaging articles, stories, and social posts.

  • You will produce your own content hands-on while also briefing and directing designers, videographers, photographers, and content writers. You are comfortable scripting video concepts, leading shoots, and working closely with creative teams to deliver polished visual assets.

  • You will audit and refine our career website, external company profiles, and job description copy to ensure our employee experience, culture, and impact-driven roles are accurately reflected for global talent.

description_html:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment.

Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. You will join the Enterprise & Governance pod, which owns the surfaces enterprise Centres of Excellence and platform administrators rely on: access control and permissions, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance features, and the administration and configuration UI for clusters and platform settings.

The role will contribute across the full stack, enabling faster end-to-end product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Discover and clarify meaningful user problems for administrators, CoE teams, and enterprise architects by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the enterprise and governance surfaces of Hub - access control, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance, and platform administration

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes, including across boundaries with Core / Identity where governance surfaces build on platform contracts

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Experience shipping product directly in a software environment

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping product in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to use AI tools effectively for first drafts, implementation steps, and iteration, while reviewing and improving weak output rather than accepting it

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to understand the user problem behind a request, use lightweight evidence and customer feedback, and make pragmatic decisions that create broader product value

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture, including the ability to test what was built, trace issues, understand frontend/backend boundaries, and contribute beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, admin/platform tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, RBAC and permission models, multi-tenancy, audit logging, or compliance-driven requirements

  • Experience designing for administrator and platform-operator personas

  • Ability to capture validation learnings clearly, distinguish signal from noise, and help improve lightweight product validation practices

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

title: DevOps Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sardine
description_html:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location:

  • Remote - Germany

  • From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere!

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

About the Role:

As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management.

You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who brings deep technical expertise, thrives in high-ownership environments, and is excited to shape the future of DevOps.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own and evolve our DevOps and platform engineering function, from build and deployment pipelines to monitoring, infrastructure as code, and cost optimization.

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that are secure, scalable, and built to support rapid product iterations without sacrificing stability.

  • Improve observability via Datadog, GCP, and custom dashboards, including FinOps focused observability outcomes.

  • Implement and maintain FinOps governance, including showback and chargeback models, to drive cost accountability across engineering teams.

  • Enable developer productivity by creating internal tooling, reusable modules, and simplifying infrastructure for other engineering teams.

  • Help teams define and measure SLOs setting the standard for how we think about system health and reliability.

  • Serve as a FinOps thought leader, collaborating with Product and Engineering to define the most cost-effective architectural patterns for new services and features.

  • Play a key role in shaping our engineering culture, DevOps best practices, and influencing our long-term DevOps roadmap.

  • Work cross-functionally with product engineering, security, finance, and other teams to align technical spending with business unit economics and financial goals.

What you'll need:

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or software engineering roles, ideally in high-growth startup environments

  • Proficiency in Python or Go, with strong software engineering fundamentals

  • Proven ownership of production infrastructure and platform tooling, with strong debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and diagnose unforeseen financial spikes

  • Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing highly secure and robust infrastructure, particularly in environments with stringent regulatory requirements such as those used by government agencies and major financial institutions

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes and tools like ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform

  • Familiarity with GCP (preferred) or other major cloud providers, with a deep focus on cloud cost management, leveraging reserved instances/savings plans, and implementing cost anomaly detection

  • Hands-on experience with dedicated FinOps tooling (e.g., Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Cloud Billing, DoIT Cloud Intelligence) or building custom tooling for cost allocation and reporting.

  • Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines and internal developer tooling from the ground up

  • Hands-on experience with observability tools like Prometheus or Datadog, and participation in an on-call rotation

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

  • 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

  • MacBook Pro delivered to your door

  • One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

  • Monthly meal stipend

  • Monthly social meet-up stipend

  • Annual health and wellness stipend

  • Annual Learning stipend

Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice.

description_html:
We're building the world's fastest way to design real, functional 3D parts. Kyrall's AI-powered design agent turns ideas into ready-to-manufacture 3D models in seconds. Backed by top European VCs, we're a young, well-funded startup based in Munich — and we're just getting started.

The Role
You'll work on our data team that owns the data our models learn from. That means sourcing 3D parametric data, writing parsers for CAD formats, and keeping the pipeline running so the AI team always has clean, usable training data.

What To Expect

  • Develop parsers that turn CAD formats into ML-compatible representations

  • Source, clean and structure 3D parametric datasets

  • Maintain and extend our data pipeline

  • Deliver datasets to the AI team and support their experiments

Your Profile

  • Studying computer science, engineering, mathematics or similar

  • Solid Python skills

  • Interest in 3D geometry, CAD or geometric data (B-Reps, meshes, point clouds)

  • Structured, self-driven way of working

  • 20 hours per week, on-site in Munich

Nice To Have

  • Experience with CAD software or libraries

  • Familiarity with data pipeline tooling

Why Kyrall?
We're reinventing how machines are designed and built, from the ground up. 3D modeling tools were the last major leap in this space, and the way we design parts today has hit its limit. You'll work directly with the founders and AI team on a small, fast-moving team — and see your work land in the product within weeks.

description_html:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich, the role will be based remotely or hybrid from Germany or Austria. As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.

 

About the role

As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.

 

What you'll do

  • Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

  • Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

  • Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

  • Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

  • Feed the product loop: surface what isn't working and translate that feedback into long-term platform improvements.

 

What you'll bring

Key attributes for success

  • Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

  • Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

  • Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

  • Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

  • Customer-first mentality. You think beyond implementation and care deeply about business outcomes and user value.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

  • Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

  • Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

  • Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

  • High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Cross-functional exposure. Work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Amazing team. Become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure. Be at the forefront of emerging technologies and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits and offsites. Paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mindpeak
description_html:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.

We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.

What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.

This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes.

This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions.

You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value.

Your Mission

  • Own the full recruiting cycle: from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing.

  • Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor: clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward.

  • Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates, particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles.

  • Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution.

  • Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value.

  • Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous.

  • You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles.

  • Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent, based on evidence rather than titles or impressions.

  • Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation.

Your Experience

  • Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus.

  • Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches, with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates.

  • Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment, recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly.

  • Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements.

  • Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes.

  • Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage but not essential.

Your Profile

  • You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed.

  • You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own.

  • You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike.

  • You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change.

  • You create structure without bureaucracy, just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability.

  • You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them.

Why Mindpeak

  • Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business.

  • Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles.

  • Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process.

  • See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment.

  • Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor.

Application Details

Please send us:

  • Your CV and reference letters

  • Your salary expectations

  • Your earliest possible starting date

Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position.

description_html:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and system engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across several complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.

 

We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

 

You’ll join a small, exceptional team of startup builders, driven by innovation and execution. Over half the team are former founders across DeepTech AI, psychedelics, and gaming. We’ve studied and worked at top institutions and companies like Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

 

The role

  • Responsible for qualifying and closing new pilot customers, from large Mittelstand companies to Tier-1 enterprises in the DACH region and beyond

  • Run product demos tailored to each customer's specific pain points

  • Build the business case and quantify the ROI for each demo client

  • Own and manage your pipeline end-to-end

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt's software, customers, and target industries

  • Work with BDRs who help feed the top of your funnel

  • First 6 months: intensive training and close collaboration with the CEO to build the industry knowledge and context needed to succeed in the role

 

You

  • You are able to easily shake off rejection

  • You write clearly, speak confidently, and know how to get to the point

  • You are able to adapt and develop practical solutions for each situation - every customer has unique challenges and goals

  • You want to grow into a domain expert - software, customers, and industry

  • You are ambitious, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile to achieve results

 

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of closing experience in B2B software sales, ideally in an industrial or technical environment

  • Alternatively, experience in technical sales or other sales position at an industrial manufacturer

  • Experience working with CRM systems (e.g. Pipedrive) and sales metrics

  • 4 days per week in the office in Munich (Meta Office, Balanstraße)

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Manufacturing and/or startup experience is a bonus

 

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience (base salary, plus uncapped commission)

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

  • 25 vacation days/per yr, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, building the function, and being responsible for its results.

 

As our founding Customer Success hire, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and have the opportunity to build Customer Success from the ground up. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

 

Interview process

  1. 30min Screening call (Nat or Malte)

  2. 1.5hr Sales Interview (CEO + team member)

  3. 1hr Culture fit interview (CEO + CPO)

  4. Offer and reference checks

We aim to complete the interview process within 14 days.

title: Business Development Representative — VIE  Germany
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Alta Ares
description_html:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

This VIE is Alta Ares' commercial entry point in Germany — the largest defence market in Europe and one undergoing the most significant defence industrial expansion since reunification. Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts.

You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline. Germany's Zeitenwende is real, budgets are moving fast, and the demand for AI and C-UAS capabilities is accelerating. You will be on the ground at the right moment.

1. Market Mapping & Opportunity Identification

  • Map Germany's defence industrial landscape: primes, systems integrators, procurement bodies (BAAINBw, Cyber Innovation Hub der Bundeswehr), and innovation initiatives (dtec.bw, IDEaS-equivalent)

  • Identify partnership and integration opportunities aligned with Alta Ares' product suite: ISR, C-UAS, AI autonomy

  • Track German defence policy, Bundeswehr procurement priorities, and Zeitenwende investment programmes

  • Produce regular market intelligence reports for the Account Manager Germany and Paris leadership team

2. Relationship Building & Business Development

  • Initiate and develop first-contact relationships with BD, engineering, and procurement teams at target accounts: Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, Diehl, ESG, BWI, and equivalent

  • Support the preparation of partner-facing materials, capability presentations, and meeting briefings

  • Qualify opportunities and escalate concrete prospects to the Account Manager Germany

  • Represent Alta Ares at key German defence events: DSEI, ILA Berlin, Eurosatory, and industry forums in Munich and Berlin

3. Germany–Paris Coordination

  • Serve as the operational bridge between Munich and Alta Ares HQ in Paris

  • Coordinate logistics for partner visits, demos, and leadership trips to Germany

  • Ensure smooth communication across time zones and cultural contexts — translating not just language but business culture

Candidate Profile

  • 0–3 years of experience — open to recent graduates and early-career profiles

  • Background in business development, international relations, political science, engineering, or a related field

  • Prior exposure to Germany (studies, internship, or work experience) is a strong plus

  • German fluency — mandatory: your accounts are German industrial companies and relationships are built in German

  • English fluency — mandatory

  • French is a meaningful plus — daily interaction with Paris HQ

  • Genuine interest in defence technology, European security, and Germany's defence industrial ecosystem

  • Organised, proactive, and comfortable building relationships from scratch in a new market

  • Culturally agile: equally at ease in a formal German industrial setting and a fast-moving French startup

VIE Eligibility: French or EU nationality — mandatory. Aged 18 to 28 at mission start. No prior VIE with the same company.

title: Head of Germany
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Complir
description_html:
About us

Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets.

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable - not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible.

We work with many of the worlds largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We’re backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we’re leading it.

About the role

We're looking for an entrepreneurial salesperson who wants huge responsibility: Bringing Complir to Germany, closing enterprise deals, and shaping our presence in Europe's biggest market.

Product compliance is not a topic that makes people lean in at dinner parties. But every product you've ever bought, from your kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. Most companies manage that wall with spreadsheets, inbox archaeology, and one very tired quality manager.

Nowhere is that wall higher than in Germany: the largest consumer market in Europe, home to the manufacturers and brands most exposed to tightening EU regulation, and a market that takes compliance more seriously than anyone. We're fixing this with AI, and we want you to be the person who brings it there.

You'll be Complir's first person on the ground in Germany, focused on enterprise: Manufacturers and brands with 1,000+ active products, complex multi-market exposure, and compliance teams drowning in spreadsheets. You'll build your own pipeline and close your own enterprise deals. That means picking up the phone, working your network, and creating opportunities where none existed, with founders and our GTM team behind every deal.

We're looking for a self-starting enterprise seller with an entrepreneurial streak - several years of enterprise B2B sales experience, ideally with some background selling into or working in legal, compliance, or regulatory functions.

Then comes the second act. As the first customers land, you build the German pod around you: account executives, customer success, eventually a German office with your fingerprints on everything. Germany is the mandate today; Austria and Switzerland follow once Germany works, and the person who built Germany is the natural owner of DACH.

Where you'll be based

You'll start with 2 weeks at our Copenhagen HQ. This is where you absorb the product, the pitch, and the compliance domain, sitting next to the founders and the GTM team, and where you start building your German pipeline from day one.

From there, you're based in Germany, running your own market. You'll be back in Copenhagen for 2 weeks every quarter, working closely with our Head of France and the rest of the team to compare notes across markets, sharpen the playbook, and bring what's working in each country back to your own.

What you'll do

  • Own the German market: pipeline, revenue, and everything in between. You build the top of your own funnel using a proven enterprise playbook, adapted to the German market: cold outreach, LinkedIn, events, and channels you develop yourself as you learn what works locally.

  • Run enterprise sales cycles end to end: discovery, demo, pilot, procurement, security review, close

  • Sell to compliance managers, regulatory affairs leads, and C-suite at product companies across categories like cosmetics, toys, and electronics

  • Become an expert in the product compliance space and act as a thought leader within the German product compliance communities

  • Bring market insight back into the product and the pitch: what German enterprises need will shape what we build

You will love this job, if you are:

  • An experienced enterprise seller with several years closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B SaaS deals, ideally in the €100k+ ACV range

  • A native-level or full professional German speaker with fluent English. You'll sell in Germany and work internally in English

  • Experienced with (or curious about) selling into compliance, regulatory, quality, or retail.

  • Comfortable being the only Complirian in your market, without being a lone wolf: you'll pull on the founders and product daily

  • Not afraid of picking up the phone. There is no SDR to start off with - the sellers who win are the ones who never stopped picking up the phone

  • A builder at heart

What you get

  • Full ownership of Germany, one of Complir’s main markets, with a real say in how it's built

  • The path from first seller to market leader: as Germany grows, you hire and lead the team

  • Be part of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance being the next big thing

  • Competitive salary and equity

title: Backend Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Linro
description_html:
About

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be one of our first engineers, building alongside the founding team. At the heart of the product is a stream-first policy engine that evaluates compliance as SQL across past, present and future infrastructure state. It has to be fast, correct and impossible to route around. You'd own large parts of it outright.

What you will do

  • Design and build core backend services in Go that evaluate policy against cloud infrastructure changes in real time.

  • Take a core area of the platform and own it end to end, from first design through running it in production.

  • Build the simulation and enforcement path that blocks or auto-remediates non-compliant changes before they reach production.

  • Stay close to customers, see how your work lands in the real world, and fold what you learn back into the product.

What we are looking for

  • Strong backend engineering experience in a compiled, statically typed language. We build in Go, so you are either already a Go engineer or someone who will get into it quickly.

  • You know SQL well and think naturally in relational and columnar data models. It’s central to how our engine works.

  • A product mindset. You care about the user and the problem, not only the ticket, and you have opinions about what to build, not just how.

  • A problem-to-solution instinct. You can take an ambiguous problem, find the simple core, and ship something that solves it.

  • End-to-end ownership. You own a problem from design through production and operation, and you see the hard parts through.

  • Hands-on experience operating and running at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure). Not just deploying to it, actually running it: access management, networking or the failure modes.

  • Hands-on with Terraform or Pulumi, and an understanding of how infrastructure-as-code actually behaves in practice.

  • You build with AI coding tools as a normal part of your workflow and have a point of view on where they help and where they don't. We build guardrails for these tools, so we want engineers with deep, hands-on experience in agentic development.

Nice to have

  • Background in cloud or cyber security, CSPM, CNAPP, or compliance (e.g. SOC 2, PCI, ISO 27001, GDPR).

  • Experience building policy or rule engines.

  • Experience with high-availability, scaling, and eventually-consistent, event-driven system design.

  • Production experience running Kubernetes clusters.

  • Early-stage startup experience, or having been a founding engineer before.

How we work

We are remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. As an early engineer you design, ship, run and own a genuine surface area of the product, with direct contact with users and a say in how we build.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously.

The honest version

This is early. Priorities will shift, and some of what you build early will change as we learn. There is no playbook waiting for you. If you want a highly structured environment with a mature codebase and a clear roadmap for the next two years, this is not it. If you want to shape a product and a category from close to the start, and you like the idea of building the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.

Compensation: €90K – €115K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Professional (T4) • €90K – €97K • Offers Equity
  • Senior (T5) • €107K – €115K • Offers Equity

description_html:
Deine Herausforderungen bei uns...

  • Technik-Hero: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unserer Abteilungen bei komplexen technischen Anfragen der Kunden zu unseren Systemen und Anwendungen.
  • Linux-Versteher: Du bewegst dich sicher auf der Linux-Konsole, um Logfiles zu analysieren (Apache, Nginx, Mail-Logs) und Ursachen für Störungen direkt zu identifizieren.
  • Besser als das FBI: Du überwachst per Monitoring unsere Serverlandschaft und schreitest schnell ein, wenn es zu internen Störungen der Infrastruktur kommt. 
  • Beratung: Du erklärst auch komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und gibst Tipps zur Optimierung der Kundenserver.
  • Schnittstelle: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Kundenbetreuung und unserem Projektmanagement zusammen, wenn es um globale Optimierungen geht, die du aus dem Support-Alltag ableitest.


Dieses Skillset bringst Du mit!

  • Hosting-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits im Webhosting-Umfeld gearbeitet und kennst die typischen "Pain Points".
  • Fundierte Linux-Kenntnisse: Du fühlst Dich auf der Kommandozeile zu Hause und weißt, wie man Kernel-Parameter und Dienste tuned.
  • Maildienste und Datenbanken: Du bist ein Experte beim Finden und Lösen von Mailproblemen (Postfix/Dovecot) und kannst sicher MySQL und MariaDB administrieren!
  • Virtualisierung und Monitoring: Systeme, um aus einem Server mehrerer virtuelle Server zu machen sind Dir nicht fremd und du kannst diese auch noch überwachen (z.B. ICINGA2)
  • Lösungsorientierung: Du denkst nicht in Problemen, sondern in stabilen, skalierbaren Lösungen.
  • Kommunikationstalent und Sprache: Du hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt, bleibst auch bei kniffligen Fällen geduldig und formulierst präzise Antworten. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und kannst technische Dokumentationen auf Englisch verstehen.


Und darum wirst Du bei uns happy!

  • Ein Unternehmen mit einem harmonischen Klima und einer Kultur, die von Verantwortung & Vertrauen, Hilfsbereitschaft & Wertschätzung, Zufriedenheit & Freude geprägt ist
  • Ein sicherer und abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsplatz
  • Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit fairem Festgehalt
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Benefits für Gesundheit und Mobilität – durch Wellpass (Sport und Fitness), JobRad (E-Bike-Leasing) und das Jobticket (öffentliche Verkehrsmit.) unterstützen wir Dich bei Deiner Gesundheit und Mobilität
  • Facharzttermine binnen 5-8 Werktagen
  • Gesundheitsbudget für Massagen, Physio, Brillen, Zähne etc. in Höhe von 600€ im Jahr
  • Videotelefonie mit Ärzten und Gesundheitstelefon
  • Gesundheitsservices (auch für Familienangehörige)
  • Förderung Deines Potenzials! Wir unterstützen Dich bei Weiterbildungen
  • Kaffee, Wasser und Obst gehen auf’s Haus
  • Foodji-Automat mit wöchentlicher Subventionierung/Arbeitgeberzuschuss für die ganze Belegschaft
  • regelmäßige Firmen-Events sorgen für Abwechslung

We’re looking for a Staff AI/ML Engineer to take technical ownership of our AI/ML work end-to-end. title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Nyala
description_html:
Ihre Aufgaben

Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 
Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach.
Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen.


Ihr Profil

Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil.


Warum wir?

Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht.

Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat.

Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at IP Dynamics GmbH
description_html:
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle

title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Lpe Immobilien Management Gmbh
description_html:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript, vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite.
  • Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness.
  • Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern: Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles.
  • Unser Stack: TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung.
  • Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js.
  • Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source.
  • Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern.
  • Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten.
  • KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt.
  • Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design.
  • Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du baust, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
  • Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich, fachlich wie persönlich.
  • Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
  • Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
  • Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.

description_html:

Mit dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den stabilen, qualitätsgerechten und termintreuen Betrieb der Produktion sowie den Aufbau eines skalierbaren Produktionssystems für unser wachsendes Space-Tech-Unternehmen in München.

  • Verantwortung für die Einhaltung standardisierter Prozesse.
  • Konsequente Umsetzung von Lean Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Transparente Berichterstattung der Produktionsperformance und Eskalation wesentlicher Risiken an das C-Level.

Dein Profil

Berufliche Erfahrung

  • Mehrjährige Führungsverantwortung in einer operativen Produktion als Produktionsleiter, Head of Production, Operations Manager oder vergleichbar.
  • Erfahrung in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Produktionsumfeld mit hohen Qualitäts- und Prozessanforderungen, vorzugsweise Aerospace, Space, MedTech, Automotive, Defense oder Präzisionstechnik.

Fachliche Kompetenzen
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Shopfloor Management und operativer Produktionsführung.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Lean Management, KVP, Standard Work, 5S, Problemlösung und Ursachenanalyse.
  • Erfahrung in der Verbesserung Ausschuss, Nacharbeit, Durchlaufzeit und Liefertermintreue.
  • Sicheres Verständnis von Qualitätsmanagement, Rückverfolgbarkeit, Prozessdisziplin und dokumentierten Arbeitsanweisungen.
  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, MES- oder digitalen Produktionsplanungssystemen sowie ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für Montage-, Fertigungs- und Testprozesse.
Führung und Persönlichkeit
  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe Präsenz auf dem Shopfloor.
  • Klare, verbindliche und konsequente Führung mit hoher Ergebnisorientierung.
  • Fähigkeit, Verantwortlichkeiten zu definieren, Entscheidungen zu treffen und deren Umsetzung nachzuhalten.
  • Hohe Problemlösungskompetenz sowie strukturierte, datenbasierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise.
  • Fähigkeit, Mitarbeiter zu entwickeln, zu qualifizieren und für klare Standards zu gewinnen.
  • Belastbarkeit und Ruhe in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Unternehmensumfeld.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Schnittstellenkompetenz sowie überzeugende Vertretung operativer Anforderungen gegenüber dem C-Level.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken, hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Bereitschaft, operative Veränderungen persönlich voranzutreiben.
Ausbildung und Sprachen
  • Abgeschlossenes technisches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium, beispielsweise Maschinenbau, Produktionstechnik, Mechatronik.
  • Alternativ technische Berufsausbildung mit Meister-, Techniker- oder vergleichbarer Weiterbildung und umfangreicher einschlägiger Führungserfahrung.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.


Wir bieten

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Mission
Bei yoursquares baust du die Systeme, mit denen wir jeden Tag arbeiten.
Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Problemen unserer Bauträger-Partner und unserem Tech-Stack entwickelst du Lösungen, die sofort im Alltag ankommen – und das ohne monatelange Abstimmung. Wir sind vollständig bootstrappt auf über 700 % Wachstum pro Jahr gekommen. Wenn du also Lust hast, unsere Produkte auf das nächste Level zu heben und dabei viel Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, dann ist das genau das Richtige für dich.

  • Du konzipierst und baust No-Code- und Low-Code-Lösungen für konkrete Probleme unserer Bauträger-Kunden. Von der ersten Idee über den Prototyp bis zum produktiven Rollout
  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Hands-on Software: kleine Tools, Skripte und Integrationen, die im Alltag sofort spürbare Wirkung zeigen, statt Monate im Backlog zu verstauben. Wie du zur Lösung kommst, entscheidest du selbst
  • Du baust unsere AI-Systeme und den dazugehörigen Tech-Stack kontinuierlich weiter von einzelnen Automatisierungen bis zur Integration neuer Modelle, APIs und Tools, sobald sie für uns relevant werden

  • Du entwickelst interne Softwaretools, mit denen andere Teams spürbar effizienter arbeiten, und wirst so zur zentralen technischen Anlaufstelle abseits der klassischen Produktentwicklung
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen eigenverantwortlich und etablierst Standards dafür, wie wir No-Code und AI bei yoursquares einsetzen mit direktem Einfluss darauf, wie das ganze Team zukünftig arbeitet


Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Weiterbildung im Bereich AI, Informatik oder Tech — oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit No-Code- und Low-Code-Plattformen wie make.com, Bubble.io, Lovable oder Zapier
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von AI-Systemen bzw. im produktiven Einsatz von GenAI-Tools.

  • Grundverständnis für Softwareentwicklung: Du liest dich in APIs, Datenstrukturen und einfache Skripte ein, ohne darauf angewiesen zu sein, dass jemand vorbaut
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du baust lieber, als lange zu planen, und stellst dein Ergebnis noch am selben Tag zur Diskussion
  • Verlässlichkeit und Belastbarkeit, auch unter Zeitdruck und wechselnden Prioritäten.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit — du erklärst technische Lösungen auch Kolleg:innen ohne Tech-Hintergrund verständlich


Was wir dir bieten:

  • Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
  • Der Zusammenhalt ist uns wichtig – diesen fördern wir durch regelmäßige gemeinsame Lunches, Dinner sowie Teamevents
  • Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Kommunikation über alle Bereiche hinweg
