title: Chief of Staff
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fleek
description_html:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year-on-year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, and others, and have recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're building Fleek's AI-native operating engine, and we need the person who runs it. As Chief of Staff, you'll operate closer to a COO than a traditional chief of staff: building the drumbeat of the company, keeping a 200-person organisation aligned across three geographies and ensuring the operating rhythm holds as we scale fast.

The timing matters. The operating structure this role builds is the structure Fleek scales on: if it isn't in place now scaling effectively becomes very difficult. You won't inherit a rhythm, you'll create it, and you'll do it AI-first: this is about building an AI-powered company, not automating a traditional one.

This is a senior leadership role with real ownership over how this company thinks, communicates and executes. Our founders are experienced and capable; your job is to multiply them.

What You'll Do

  • Build the company brain: design our AI-native information architecture and knowledge flows so the right people know the right things at the right time, across every team and geography.

  • Own the operating rhythm: build and run the cadence that doesn't exist today: weekly and quarterly business reviews, OKRs, goal-tracking and cross-functional alignment across three geographies.

  • Create founder leverage: make the founders meaningfully more productive and effective through hyper-growth: owning their priorities, filtering what reaches them and driving what leaves their desk to completion.

  • Run investor relations: own the cadence and quality of investor updates, keeping our backers (a16z, YC, HV Capital and others) close and informed as we scale.

  • Build communication infrastructure: define how decisions get made, documented, communicated and followed through at scale, internally and externally.

  • Turn patterns into systems: wherever the company repeats itself, find the pattern, build the process or the agent that runs it and get out of the way.

  • Be the connective tissue: spot misalignment between teams and geographies before it becomes a problem and fix it without being asked.

What You Bring

You're one of two profiles:

Ex-founder, operator at scale. You've built something yourself and you've worked inside a fast-scaling company. You know what 200 people looks like from the inside, you've seen what breaks and you know how to stop it happening.

Senior operator ready for a bigger seat. You've been in a chief of staff, strategy, or senior ops role at a high-growth startup or scaleup. You've built the operating systems companies run on and you're ready to own them end to end in a company moving faster.

In both cases, you are:

  • Deeply AI-native. You use AI tools instinctively and you're thinking about how to build an AI-powered company, not just automate tasks. You can show the systems and prompts behind how you work.

  • A systems thinker. You find the pattern, build the process and get out of the way. You'd rather build something repeatable than be the bottleneck it depends on.

  • A sharp communicator. You write clearly, synthesise fast and can represent the founder's credibly to a room of investors or a floor of operators.

  • Trusted with everything. You handle sensitive company, people and investor information with total discretion and sound judgment.

  • Comfortable at pace. Fleek moves fast and expects the same from everyone. Shifting priorities energise you rather than rattle you.

  • Genuinely excited to build the operating system of a company defining a category that didn't exist three years ago.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in marketplaces, commerce, or supply chain businesses

  • Exposure to fundraising, board management, or investor communications

  • Experience working across multiple geographies and time zones

What You'll Get

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

  • Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek

  • Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office

  • A disproportionate level of responsibility and the opportunity to drive massive impact

How We Work

Fleek is an in-office company. We're based at Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East). We operate a fully in-person culture at our office in Shoreditch, with trust-based flexibility. We hire adults and trust them to perform.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East)

  • Work model: On-site, with trust-based flexibility

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 200 across three geographies

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

Success Metrics

  • First 30 days: deep understanding of how Fleek runs today: every team, geography, and founder workflow mapped, with the first version of the operating cadence proposed.

  • 3 months: weekly and quarterly business reviews, OKRs and goal-tracking live and holding across all three geographies; investor update cadence owned end to end.

  • 6 months: the company brain operational: AI-native knowledge flows in place, decision-making documented and followed through, measurable time returned to the founder's calendar.

  • 12 months: the company runs as a system, not a person. The operating rhythm scales with headcount and leadership treats it as infrastructure they can't work without.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

In this role, you will bring concepts to life through compelling animation, character performance, camera work, environmental storytelling, and cinematic visuals. You will work closely with creative, marketing, and product teams to create engaging content that elevates the BJAK brand while mentoring junior artists and helping define animation standards across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

3D Animation & Creative Execution

  • Develop engaging character, object, and environmental animations that communicate ideas effectively.

  • Translate storyboards and creative concepts into polished 3D animated content.

  • Produce cinematic camera movements, transitions, and visual sequences that enhance audience engagement.

  • Ensure consistency in animation quality, visual style, and brand identity across all deliverables.

Creative Direction & Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Product, and Content teams to develop compelling visual narratives.

title: Technical Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Bjak
description_html:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Staff Data Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Beamery
description_html:
ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Deepening our native integrations with SAP, Workday, Microsoft, and LinkedIn to seamlessly embed our skills intelligence into the platforms where critical workforce decisions are made.

Embedding our agentic AI to help customers plan smarter for the future—powering workforce strategies, internal mobility, and skills forecasting.

Advancing our use of proprietary LLMs and knowledge graph technology to help organizations unlock broader talent pools, make fairer decisions, and expand access to opportunity at scale.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the opportunity

Our data platform powers Beamery’s reporting and underpins our AI strategy. We’re hiring a Staff Data Engineer to set its technical direction.

This is our most senior individual contributor role in data engineering. You’ll own the platform’s long-term architecture, make the calls that are expensive to reverse, and lead the work that follows. You’ll also partner with EPD leadership (Engineering, Product, and Design) on work that crosses team boundaries, and on keeping the platform aligned with company strategy. The platform exists so everyone at Beamery can make faster decisions with data they trust. The role suits someone energised by ambiguity who measures impact by what the organisation can do rather than what they personally shipped.

What will you be doing at Beamery?

  • Own the technical strategy for the data platform. Define the multi-quarter architectural vision, build the case for investment with EPD leadership, and sequence delivery incrementally rather than as a big-bang migration. You take on the work with no established playbook and turn it into designs the team can execute. Expect challenges around multi-tenant consistency, correctness at scale, performance ceilings, and data modelling for AI and agentic workloads.

  • Architect the analytics, semantic, and AI data layers. Define how core business metrics, feature usage signals, and skills and task intelligence data are modelled, governed, and exposed as trustworthy products to BI, self-service, and AI consumers.

  • Set standards that scale beyond your team. Establish the architectural patterns, modelling conventions, and data contracts other teams adopt, favouring guardrails over review gates. Grow senior engineers into stronger technical decision-makers through design review, pairing, and mentorship.

  • Own reliability and trust at the platform level. Set our approach to observability, data quality, SLAs, and incident response; lead RCAs on the most serious failures and drive the systemic fixes that prevent recurrence.

What we’re looking for

You’re a staff-level data engineer who has built and run data platforms for internal and external consumers. You’ve built architectures that held up as they grew with a focus on data warehousing, data lakes, and both real-time and batch processing.

Teams bring you their hardest data problems. You’ve made the hard tradeoffs in distributed, multi-tenant systems and lived with the consequences. You’re just as comfortable in production: tracing how one upstream failure ripples through to customers, and making sound calls under pressure.

Your impact isn’t measured in code alone. You’ve led initiatives across team boundaries without formal authority, working directly with principal engineers, platform teams, and data scientists, and treating their constraints as part of your design problem. You’ve made architectural decisions others built on for years, and driven modernisation while balancing new technology against real delivery risk. You work with minimal direction, explain tradeoffs and risks credibly to executive audiences, and change your mind as readily as you defend a position.

Previous professional experience:

  • Data transformations using dbt, including patterns for large, complex projects

  • Data storage (SQL / NoSQL): schema design, modelling at scale, and multi-tenant isolation

  • Back-end engineering: Python (nice to have: Typescript/Node.JS)

  • Pipelines: streaming, CDC, correctness, replayability, and evolution over time

  • Data quality and observability: validation, testing, data contracts, monitoring, alerting, and incident response

  • Infrastructure as code and containerisation (Terraform, Kubernetes)

Our data stack

Our stack will change as we grow, and you’ll be shaping those changes. The ability to learn new tools matters more than experience with any specific one.

  • DBT for data modelling and transformation

  • BigQuery data warehouse

  • Kafka for data streaming between systems

  • PostgreSQL & MongoDB for databases

  • Typescript/Node.JS on the backend

  • Kubernetes

  • Python

  • Segment for customer-centric event collection

Beamery is open to engage with direct employment or contractors for this position in order to find the right fit candidate to join our team.

Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. If, for whatever reason, you need us to make reasonable adjustments and adaptations to our recruitment process, please email Visit our Diversity, Equality and Inclusion page to learn more about progress and commitments.

Compensation: £98,450 – £130,000

  • • £98,450 – £130,000

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Primer.io
description_html:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be our first Senior Engineer in ML, working alongside our Staff Engineer to help build the foundations from the ground up. There's no existing DS/ML team yet, so the two of you will shape it together, working closely with engineering, data, and product, who are already exploring how ML can be used in payments. There's a lot still to figure out and a lot to build. You'll work closely with your team's stakeholders to identify where ML can move the needle, and report to engineering leadership while that function takes shape.

What will you be doing?

  • Own the full lifecycle of ML-powered features within your initiatives - from independently researching and testing approaches through training, deployment and monitoring in production

  • Productionise smart routing decisions across the payment flow, building the ML infrastructure around them as you go - versioning, CI/CD, observability

  • Partner closely with product, data and engineering to turn promising use cases into shipped, measured outcomes

  • Bring a pragmatic, impact-first mindset to experimentation and model evaluation, rather than chasing the most sophisticated approach

  • Mentor other engineers as they pick up ML techniques, sharing how you think about tradeoffs and when to keep things simple

  • Talk directly to customers to validate ideas and pressure-test what you're building against real usage

  • Help set technical direction within your area, working with your team to prioritise the use cases worth pursuing

  • Establish patterns and practices that make ML work reliable and repeatable at Primer, building on foundations rather than defining them alone

What we're looking for

  • Senior experience in ML engineering, data science, or applied research, with real production deployments behind you (API, batch, or streaming)

  • You think statistically. You can design and run experiments and A/B tests, and report what the results do and don't show

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch or Keras

  • Solid grounding in modern software engineering, infrastructure and data tooling, and an understanding of the MLOps challenges across the full ML lifecycle. You don't need to have built a platform, but you know what one has to handle

  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning (multi-armed or contextual bandits, for example). Production experience with it isn't required, but you need to understand how it works and where it applies

  • Cloud experience — AWS preferred; GCP or Azure both fine

  • Exposure to payments or e-commerce is a plus, not a prerequisite - you'll build that domain depth on the job

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, in the problems and in the process. You can research, develop and productionise independently, and you'll help define how we work as you go

You may not like it here

  • You enjoy working in an office setting — we're remote-first, and always will be

  • You need a fully mapped-out roadmap before you start — we're building this function, and there is a lot yet to be defined.

  • You prefer handing models to another team to deploy and run.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

About Mercor

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role

As a Growth Associate, you’ll connect leading AI companies with the specialized experts they need—from engineers to medical professionals—to train and evaluate cutting-edge models. Your work will directly drive millions in revenue and shape the future of AI. Our team works 6 days per week (5 days in-office in London).

  • Manage Talent Pipelines: Oversee multiple recruiting and sourcing pipelines to deliver qualified experts at scale.

  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Project Managers, Product, and Engineering to improve sourcing workflows and deliver high-quality results.

  • Drive Growth: Your recruiting and sourcing efforts will be a core driver of Mercor’s rapid expansion.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1-2 years of prior experience in lead generation, outbound sales, or recruiting

  • Strong familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter / Sales Navigator and other sourcing tools

  • Comfortable driving high conversion rates and managing funnels effectively

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • A track record of thriving in fast-paced, results-driven environments (startups, consulting, finance, or similar).

  • A motivated, goal-oriented mindset with the resilience to meet ambitious targets.

Benefits

  • Bi-annual performance bonus structure

  • Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

  • Up to $15k Relocation bonus

  • $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

  • $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

  • Free Equinox membership

  • $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

  • $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

title: Lead Data Engineer, Portugal

description_html:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Location Portugal | Compensation package €80,000 - €100,000 base + Bonus + Share Options + Benefits | Ways of working remote with quarterly visits to our London office

About the Role

We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer to be a technical authority within our data engineering function, helping to shape and evolve our data platform to meet Zego’s ambitious growth.

This is a hands-on technical role- you’ll design and build scalable, resilient, and secure data systems, while acting as a mentor and technical guide for other engineers. You’ll work closely with peers across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Product to ensure our data infrastructure is efficient, reliable, and future-proof.

While this role doesn’t involve direct line management, you’ll be expected to foster technical excellence within the team by sharing knowledge, reviewing code, and coaching others.

 

What you will be doing

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Act as a senior technical reference point for the Data Engineering team.

  • Mentor and coach other engineers, helping them grow their technical skills and deliver high-quality work.

  • Promote best practices in data engineering, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure as code.

Platform & Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure data pipelines, warehouses, and streaming systems.

  • Ensure data is modelled and structured to meet the needs of analytics, data science, and operational use cases.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our data architecture, ensuring it can support both current and future business needs.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with teams across the business to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.

  • Identify opportunities for optimisation, re-architecture, or tool improvements.

  • Contribute to the definition and execution of the technical roadmap for data engineering.

 

About You

You’re a hands-on engineer who thrives on solving complex problems and helping others do their best work. You bring technical depth, a pragmatic mindset, and a collaborative approach to everything you do.

 

What You Bring:

  • Experience: 5+ years as a Data Engineer working on scalable data platforms, ideally in product-led or high-growth environments.

  • Technical Skills:

    • Proven expertise in designing, building, and operating ETL/ELT pipelines and large-scale data architectures.

    • Deep hands-on experience with modern data stacks — our tech includes Python, SQL, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, AWS S3, PostgresDB, Airflow, dbt, and Apache Spark, deployed via AWS, Docker, and Terraform (experience with similar technologies is essential).

  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, translating technical concepts into business value.

  • Mentorship: Demonstrated experience in supporting the growth of other engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

  • Problem-Solving: Pragmatic approach to balancing technical excellence with delivery needs.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building Data Mesh or Lakehouse architectures.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, and real-time streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka, Kinesis).

  • Exposure to ML engineering pipelines or MLOps frameworks.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

description_html:
We are Vitesse – the treasury and payment partner of choice for insurance.

Your next adventure awaits!

Join the team who are redefining the payments space.

About Us

At Vitesse, we're more than just a payments platform – we're the trusted financial infrastructure connecting the global insurance ecosystem. Tailor-made for insurers, brokers, MGAs, and TPAs, our unified platform optimises claims funds, enables real-time global payments, and delivers full financial control. Our impact is real: over $20 billion in payments across 200+ countries, hundreds of millions returned to insurers’ balance sheets, and counting. We’re licensed in the UK (FCA), Europe (DNB), and New York (NYDFS), with over 260 amazing colleagues worldwide. With $93 million recently raised in Series C funding from KKR, our journey is just beginning, and our ambitions are sky-high.

Headquartered in the heart of London and expanding across Europe and the US, Vitesse is where your ideas power tomorrow’s insurance solutions. Are you ready to make a difference? You're in the right place.

YOUR MISSION

As Senior People Partner supporting Product Engineering and Operations at Vitesse, you will operate as a strategic advisor to senior leaders, shaping and delivering a high-impact People strategy that drives performance, engagement, and scalable growth.

This role goes beyond operational HR support you will influence leadership capability, organisational design, talent strategy, and culture in a fast-moving fintech environment. You will balance commercial acumen with people expertise to ensure our teams can perform at their best while building a sustainable, inclusive and high-performing culture.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic People Partnership

  • Partner with senior leaders to translate business objectives into actionable People strategies.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and coach to leaders, driving accountability and high performance.

Talent Strategy & Workforce Planning

  • Drive and take ownership of the workforce planning and support the Talent Acquisition team to shape hiring plans aligned to business growth and skills needs.

  • You will play an active role in supporting recruitment through coaching hiring managers to elevate hiring standards and ensure consistent, high-quality selection processes.

  • Proactively identify capability gaps and future talent risks within Product Engineering and Operations.

Performance & High-Performance Culture

  • Lead performance management cycles, ensuring robust goal setting, feedback, calibration, and development planning is in operation and meeting our standards.

  • Enable managers to confidently manage both high and low performance.

  • Embed a culture of continuous feedback, accountability, and growth.

Leadership & Capability Development

  • Diagnose development needs across teams and implement targeted learning initiatives.

  • Coach managers to strengthen leadership capability, employee engagement, and team effectiveness.

  • Support succession planning and internal mobility strategies.

Employee Relations & Risk Management

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and manager all employee relations matters within your functions and support others when and where appropriate.

  • Provide balanced, commercially sound guidance that mitigates risk while maintaining trust.

  • Ensure People practices align with employment law and regulatory requirements whilst staying in line with our people centric approach.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

  • Embed inclusive leadership practices across Product Engineering and Operations.

  • Partner with leaders to drive equitable talent outcomes across hiring, performance, and progression.

  • Use data insights to identify and address systemic gaps.

Engagement & Culture

  • Translate engagement data into actionable insights and support with driving measurable improvements.

  • Lead retention strategies for critical talent populations.

  • Strengthen cross-functional collaboration and cultural alignment.

People Analytics & Insight

  • Leverage People data to inform decision-making and influence leadership conversations.

  • Track and report on key metrics including attrition, performance distribution, hiring effectiveness, and engagement trends.

  • Use insights to proactively identify organisational risks and opportunities.

Change & Transformation

  • Lead the People aspects of organisational change, including restructures, team evolution, and process transformation.

  • Ensure thoughtful communication, impact assessment, and change adoption strategies.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Significant experience as a Senior HR Business Partner or Senior People Partner in a fast-paced, scaling environment ideally fintech or technology.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with Product, Engineering, or Technical teams.

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to link People strategy to business performance.

  • Deep understanding of employment law, regulatory frameworks, and People best practices.

  • Proven capability managing complex employee relations and organisational change.

  • A strong work ethic with high levels of ownership and accountability.

  • The confidence and credibility to operate independently, while also collaborating effectively as part of a wider People and leadership team.

  • Strong coaching and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate People data into strategic insights.

  • A genuine passion for HR and driving our business forward as well as passion for enabling Product and Technology teams to do their best work.

We understand that everyone has their own work rhythm and believe in a flexible working schedule - at Vitesse you’re expected to work 35 hours a week.

Our Values – or what we call “Vitesse at Our Best”

The Vitesse values are a true reflection of what it takes to thrive in our business, so it’s important to us that any employee who joins our business is aligned with these 3 attributes

Confident Humility
We believe the best ideas come from listening and learning. We leave ego at the door, ask for help when we need it, and celebrate collective success. When one of us wins, we all do.

Driven to Succeed
We’re ambitious about the opportunity ahead and committed to achieving it together. We hold ourselves to high standards, take pride in what we deliver, and push for meaningful outcomes for our customers, our partners, and each other.

Tenacious Responsibility
We take ownership of our work, our decisions, and our results. We face challenges with resilience, learn from setbacks, and see things through to completion. Because doing the right thing matters.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

We commit to creating an inclusive environment that enables everyone to perform at their best, where we recognise the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and where there is an unbiased acceptance of others. Our policies and practices aim to promote an environment that is free from all forms of unlawful or unfair discrimination and values the diversity of all people. At the heart of our policy, we seek to treat people fairly and with dignity and respect. title: Backend Engineer (Security)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Triggerdev
description_html:
About us

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the position

We're looking for a backend product engineer who loves security - not a security box-ticker. You'll build and own the systems that let Trigger safely run massive volumes of untrusted user code inside our infrastructure, at scale.

Some of our customers let their own users run untrusted code on top of Trigger - think coding agents executing arbitrary instructions. We have to guarantee that code can never break Trigger's systems, or our customers' systems. That makes this partly a product engineering role: building secure sandbox runtimes is a feature we ship, not something bolted on after the fact.

The ideal person here is a backend engineer with genuine offensive-security instincts - someone who naturally gravitates toward hacking, pen testing, and breaking things, and brings that curiosity into how they build. You'll pair strong backend/product instincts with a hacker's mindset.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

Sandbox and runtime security. Designing and maintaining the secure execution environments that isolate untrusted user code - the core, product-shaped problem at the heart of this role.

Threat detection and incident response. Building monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, and leading the response when something needs investigating.

Vulnerability management, end to end. Regular scanning and triage, plus AI-assisted security scans run on a quarterly cadence, and triaging incoming disclosures.

Offensive security. Running internal, AI-assisted pen testing, and potentially bringing in external firms for deeper engagements.

PR security review. Adding a security-specific review layer on top of our normal PR process.

SOC 2 and compliance. Mostly done already - this is about ongoing maintenance, not standing it up from scratch.

Vulnerability disclosure process. Owning our vulnerability disclosure program end to end.

Security culture. Helping the wider engineering team build secure habits - reviews, documentation, and pragmatic guardrails rather than heavy process.

Working at a Commercial Open Source Software company is more than just security work:

  • We have an active community on Discord and GitHub. Everyone on the team helps customers, reviews PRs, and creates issues.

  • Having great documentation is essential. Everyone writes docs.

  • We're a product-led growth company, so everyone is expected to get involved in creating content like code examples, blog articles, videos, and tweets.

Requirements

Real backend engineering experience. You can design and ship production backend systems, not just audit someone else's.

Genuine offensive-security curiosity. Pen testing, CTFs, bug bounty hunting, or hacking as a hobby or discipline - this isn't a checklist role.

Comfort owning ambiguous, product-shaped security problems. Sandboxing and runtime isolation are engineering problems as much as they are security ones.

A proactive mindset. This role should take work off the team's plate, not create a queue for others - we're not looking for a security box-ticker.

Comfortable being on call. Reliability and security response are shared responsibilities across the team.

Open to in-person events throughout the year. If you're remote, we'll arrange these so the team gets real time together.

You'll be an amazing fit if you have:

  • Experience building or hardening sandboxed/isolated execution environments (containers, microVMs, gVisor, Firecracker, WASM sandboxes, or similar).

  • A track record in pen testing, bug bounty programs, or CTFs.

  • Experience using AI-assisted tooling for security scanning or workflows.

  • A proven track record of contributing to open source projects.

  • Worked at a developer tools, infrastructure, or open source company.

  • Experience with Node.js and TypeScript, enough to read and review application code.

Benefits

Generous, transparent compensation and equity - we hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity so everyone is invested in the company's success.

Async working - need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

Home office - we help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

Generous vacation - 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

Training budget - an annual budget to contribute towards learning, such as books, an Audible subscription, or online courses.

Pension contributions - enroll in our company pension scheme, or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

Our values

We are proud to be open source - we believe in the open source community and building a great free-to-use product.

We ship uncomfortably fast - as a startup, moving fast is key. We are pragmatic about what we build, when we build it.

Working autonomously - we don't tell you what to do. We decide as a team what will have the biggest impact for our customers and prioritise from that.

title: Senior Consultant Konzernkunden / Strategieberatung (m/w/d)

description_html:
Worum geht's?

Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert.

Und du hast gemerkt: Die Decks werden größer, die Hierarchien länger, dein Impact auf die eigentliche Entscheidung wird kleiner. Up-or-out, 60-Stunden-Wochen für die Marke eines anderen, drei Freigabeschleifen bevor du mit dem Mandanten überhaupt sprechen darfst.

Bei SC Ventures drehen wir das um: Du übernimmst eigene Mandate bei etablierten Unternehmen mit wachsender Komplexität und sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Vorstand. Keine Pyramide dazwischen. Keine drei Partner, die sich vorher abstimmen müssen.

Was du bei einer Big4/MBB-Beratung an Struktur, Methodik und Executive-Kommunikation gelernt hast, bringst du zu uns – und wirst gleichzeitig daran beteiligt, was du aufbaust: Sobald deine Bestandskunden verlängern, bekommst du eine vertraglich geregelte Umsatzbeteiligung. Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung.

Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Du gestaltest mit, wie dieser Bereich strukturiert wird, nicht nur, wie er ausgeführt wird.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

  • Du verantwortest eigenständig Beratungsmandate für Unternehmen mit wachsender Größe und Komplexität – von der Ansprache auf Geschäftsführungs-/Vorstandsebene bis zur Umsetzungssteuerung
  • Du entwickelst Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodelle für Vertriebs- und CRM-Transformation und verantwortest deren Umsetzung – nicht nur die Folie dazu
  • Du führst Strategie-Workshops und Steering-Committees auf C-Level-Niveau
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die methodische Basis für den Enterprise-Bereich mit auf: Angebotsstruktur, Delivery-Standards, Qualitätssicherung
  • Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von SC Ventures im Enterprise-Segment

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ab Senior Consultant / Berater-Level) bei einer Top-Strategieberatung (MBB, Big4-Consulting o. ä.) oder vergleichbarer Inhouse-Strategiefunktion
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen/Geschäftsführungen von Unternehmen relevanter Größenordnung
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Transformationsprojekte eigenständig zu strukturieren und zu verantworten – ohne engmaschige Freigabeprozesse
  • Executive Presence: Du überzeugst auf Augenhöhe, ohne dich hinter einer großen Marke verstecken zu müssen
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung und Beteiligung, nicht nur ein Gehalt
  • Branchenkenntnis Bildungssektor/AZAV von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – die Beratungslogik zählt mehr als die Sektor-Historie

Benefits

Was du davon hast:

  • Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Bestandskunden – vertraglich geregelt, ohne Politik
  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen
  • Schnelle Entscheidungswege – keine drei Freigabeschleifen zwischen dir und dem Mandanten
  • Kein Up-or-out – dein Wert bemisst sich an Ergebnissen, nicht an Politik oder Tenure
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Beteiligungsmodell
  • Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und klare Perspektive Richtung Partner-Modell/Teamleitung
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, MacBook & iPhone
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern statt anonymer Konzernstruktur

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du kommst aus der Top-Beratung und willst nicht mehr für die Marke eines anderen liefern. Du willst eigene Mandate, echte Beteiligung und Entscheidungen, die auch wirklich deine sind.

Wenn du lieber baust als verwaltest und lieber mit einem kleinen Team etwas Großes aufziehst, als in einem großen Team ein kleines Rädchen zu sein – dann bist du hier richtig.

title: Consultant Education & Sales Operations (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Strategy Core Ventures GmbH
description_html:
Worum geht’s?

Du hast genug von einem Job ohne Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten – ohne Verantwortung, ohne Aufstieg, ohne echtes Ergebnis?

Bei SC Ventures übernimmst du echte Verantwortung – aber nicht für die Umsetzung, sondern für die Führung und Beratung:
Du arbeitest im direkten Austausch mit den Geschäftsführungen zertifizierter Bildungsträger (AZAV) und begleitest sie beim Aufbau skalierbarer Vertriebs- und CRM-Strukturen.

Dabei trainierst du deren Vertriebsteams anhand bewährter Vorlagen, Methoden und Prozesse – mit dem Ziel, Vertriebsergebnisse messbar zu verbessern.
Du berätst, führst und steuerst.

**Wenn du Ergebnisse lieferst, wirst du daran beteiligt:
**Ab dem zweiten Jahr erhältst du eine Umsatzbeteiligung an deinen Bestandskunden – transparent, leistungsbasiert und ohne Politik. Die Beteiligung ist vertraglich geregelt und greift, sobald einer deiner betreuten Kunden seinen Beratungsvertrag mit uns verlängert.

Damit profitierst du direkt von nachhaltigen Ergebnissen und Kundenbindung – kein leeres Versprechen, sondern echtes Mitverdienen.

Wir reden nicht über Skalierung – wir setzen sie um.

Jährlich werden über 50 Bildungsträger Partnerbetrieb von SC Ventures – weil wir nicht nur beraten, sondern aus der Praxis kommen.
Wir selbst haben innerhalb von drei Jahren einen Bildungsträger mit über 50 Teammitgliedern aufgebaut – durch klare Vertriebs- und CRM-Strukturen, bundesweite Sichtbarkeit und messbare Ergebnisse. Dieses Fundament bildet heute die Grundlage unserer Beratung für andere Bildungsträger.

Jetzt suchen wir dich:

Eine umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Beratungs-Drive, die Bildungsträger gemeinsam mit deren Geschäftsführungen und Vertriebsteams führt, fordert und entwickelt.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Vertriebsteam unserer Kunden
  • Du entwickelst und implementierst Vertriebsstrategien und CRM-Prozesse
  • Du schulst und steuerst die internen Vertriebsteams der Bildungsträger auf Basis unserer Vorlagen und Strukturen
  • Du analysierst Vertriebsdaten, identifizierst Engpässe und steuerst gezielt nach
  • Du übernimmst die vollständige Verantwortung für ein festes Kundenportfolio (ca. 15 Bildungsträger)
  • Du führst regelmäßige Jour-Fixes, Strategie-Sessions und Review-Calls
  • Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Beratungsstruktur ein – kein Dienst nach Vorschrift, sondern Mitgestaltung

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung in B2C oder B2B-Vertrieb, CRM-Prozessen, Organisationsentwicklung oder strategischer Beratung
  • Fähigkeit, sowohl mit Geschäftsführern als auch operativen Vertriebsteams zu arbeiten
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, KPI-Denken und klare Umsetzungsorientierung
  • Kommunikationsstärke, souveränes Auftreten und Prozessdenken
  • Bonus: Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, SaaS, Vertriebsarchitektur oder Schulung von Vertriebsteams

Benefits

Was du davon hast:

  • Umsatzbeteiligung ab Jahr 2 auf deine Bestandskunden – bei starker Performance, direkt messbar
  • Festes Kundenportfolio ab Tag 1 nach Einarbeitung – keine operative Hektik, keine Akquise
  • Home-Office nach Einarbeitung – Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, moderne Ausstattung inkl. MacBook & iPhone
  • Attraktives Einstiegsgehalt zwischen 48.000 € und 55.000 € brutto jährlich – abhängig von Erfahrung und bisherigen Ergebnissen
  • Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und individueller Entwicklungsplan – für fachliche Tiefe oder Führungsausbau
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest unsere Beratungsprodukte aktiv mit
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Regelungen – dein Ergebnis zählt, nicht dein Stundenzettel
  • Tiefes Onboarding, strukturierte Übergabeprozesse und Zugriff auf gebündeltes Know-how aus über 50 Projekten pro Jahr
  • Klare Karriereperspektive Richtung Teamleitung oder Fachverantwortung

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du willst gestalten, statt verwalten.
Du denkst in Lösungen, nicht in Zuständigkeiten.
Du bringst Vertriebserfahrung mit und kannst auf Augenhöhe mit Geschäftsführungen kommunizieren.

Dann bist du bei uns richtig.Wir suchen keine Mitläufer – sondern Menschen mit Drive, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Strukturen mitentwickeln wollen.
Bei SC Ventures agierst du wie ein Unternehmer im Unternehmen: mit klaren Zielen, viel Eigenverantwortung und direkter Wirkung auf die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden.

description_html:
Gestalten Sie den Auftritt von Krämer Druck aktiv mit!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine kreative und zugleich gut organisierte Persönlichkeit, die unser Marketing eigenständig betreut und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt. Sie müssen nicht jede Aufgabe bereits beherrschen. Wenn Sie gern Verantwortung übernehmen und Ideen selbstständig umsetzen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmens- und Karriereseiten sowie unserer Social-Media-Kanäle
  • Planung und Erstellung von Texten, Fotos und Videos für verschiedene Kanäle
  • Gestaltung von Print- und Digitalmedien, darunter Newsletter und Messeunterlagen
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Markenauftritts und Sicherstellung eines einheitlichen Erscheinungsbilds
  • Auswertung unserer digitalen Kanäle und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen
  • Planung von Messen und Veranstaltungen in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsleitung, Fachabteilungen und externen Partnern

Qualifikation

  • Eine Ausbildung, ein Studium oder praktische Erfahrung in Marketing, Gestaltung und Kommunikation
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Sprache und Markenauftritt
  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Grafikprogrammen der Adobe Creative Cloud sowie im Content Management-System WordPress
  • Interesse an Fotografie und Video sowie an der Erstellung eigener Inhalte
  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Firmenfahrrad über Bikeleasing
  • Regelmäßige Guthabenkarte für den regionalen Einzelhandel und Tankstellen (Sachbezug)
  • Freiwilliges Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld
  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
  • Kollegiales Umfeld und ein super Team
  • Moderner, ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
  • Sehr umfassende Einarbeitung in das jeweilige Tätigkeitsfeld
  • Corporate Benefits: Rabatte bei über 800 Marken – online und vor Ort

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht allein Ihre Berufsbezeichnung, sondern die passende Kombination aus Kreativität, Organisation und Eigeninitiative.

  • Beherrschen aller gängigen Plattformen: META, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube
  • Content Creation mit Hands-on Mentalität sowie das Erstellen von Briefings für das Marketing-Team
  • Regelmäßige Analyse der wichtigsten KPI, um schnelles Wachstum zu gewährleisten und den besten Content für jeden Channel zu identifizieren

  • Du bist Bild-, Text- und Video-Experte/in und kannst die Inhalte sowohl selbst erstellen als auch abnehmen
  • Du bist digitale Experte/in und kannst nicht nur mit gängigen Social Media Tools (bspw. Meta, InShot, Canva) arbeiten, sondern eignest dir auch regelmäßig die
    Nutzung neuer Tools an (bspw. ChatGTP etc.)

Benefits

  •   U.v.m.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Kuhn & Partner Rechtsanwälte Steuerberater Wirtschaftsprüfer mbB
description_html:
kuhn.partner

Wir stellen uns Dir vor.

Ein Partner, auf den man sich verlassen kann. Was wie eine Floskel klingen mag, ist elementarer Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur und spiegelt sich in dem täglichen Miteinander mit unseren Mandanten und Mitarbeitern wider. Wir möchten Menschen voranbringen und nachhaltig bei deren individuellen Zielen unterstützen. Wir, das sind über 50 Teammitglieder, gemeinsam mit Kompetenzen in allen Bereichen des Steuerrechts, und zwar sowohl in der laufenden Beratung als auch in der Gestaltungsberatung. Von unseren Standorten in Nackenheim bei Mainz, Frankfurt am Main und München beraten wir national und international tätige Unternehmen und unternehmerische Privatpersonen durch unseren ganzheitlichen Beratungsansatz weit über die Themengebiete der klassischen steuerlichen Compliance.

Aufgaben

Wir erarbeiten Dein individuelles Tätigkeitsprofil.

Unsere Branche steht vor einem großen Umbruch. Der Einsatz von KI, neue Beratungsfelder und eine zunehmend komplexe Gesetzgebung sorgen dafür, dass die Steuerberatung von morgen ganz anders aussehen wird. Gestalte diesen Wandel mit uns und entwickle an der Schnittstelle von Digitalisierung, IT und Steuern unsere Kanzleistruktur der Zukunft. Konkret kannst Du Dich auf einen spannenden Tätigkeitsmix aus vielschichtigen DATEV- und KI-Projekten freuen. Du sorgst demzufolge dafür, dass wir unsere bestehenden Programme noch besser nutzen und gestaltest darüber hinaus den vollständigen Veränderungsprozess, wenn wir uns auf Basis Deiner Expertise für die Einführung neuer Tools entschieden haben. Unsere Branche und wir sind bereit für Veränderungen – bist Du es auch?

Qualifikation

Du solltest Dich in den folgenden Bereichen wiederfinden.

Du kannst Dich auf uns verlassen, wir sollten uns auf Dich verlassen können. Dies bezieht sich nicht nur auf die Beratung unserer Mandanten, sondern beinhaltet auch, dass Du Dich gerne in unser Team einbringst und zu unserem „Wir-Gefühl“ beiträgst.

Des Weiteren wäre es wünschenswert, wenn Du Dich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden würdest:

description_html:
IndiaWorks ist ein junges Unternehmen, das sich auf die Rekrutierung und Integration von internationalen Fachkräften und Auszubildenden spezialisiert hat. Unsere Mission: Wir schaffen Brücken zwischen deutschen Unternehmen und hochqualifizierten Talenten aus Indien, um den Fachkräftemangel gezielt zu bekämpfen. Mit uns erleben Sie ein positives, internationales und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Ihre Ideen und Ihr Engagement geschätzt werden.

Aufgaben

  • Vertriebsstrategie gestalten und skalieren: Aufbau, Strukturierung und laufende Optimierung unserer B2B-Vertriebsprozesse von der Leadgenerierung bis zum Abschluss
  • Teamaufbau & -führung: Verantwortung für den Aufbau eines engagierten Vertriebsteams inklusive Rekrutierung, Einarbeitung, Coaching und Performance-Management
  • Neukundengeschäft entwickeln: Identifikation und proaktive Ansprache potenzieller Kunden aus Schlüsselbranchen (z. B. Pflege, Handwerk, Industrie, IT)
  • Bestandskundengeschäft ausbauen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit bestehenden Kunden zur Identifikation neuer Potenziale und langfristiger Bindung
  • Eigenes Business Development: Sie sind in der Anfangsphase selbst operativ aktiv im Vertrieb und gehen mit gutem Beispiel voran

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Bereich Personalvermittlung, HR-Services oder Recruiting
  • Nachweisliche Erfolge im Aufbau und der Führung von Vertriebsteams
  • Unternehmerisches Denken und Hands-on-Mentalität – Sie können strategisch denken, aber auch operativ liefern
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungsstärke
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1 in Deutsch)

Benefits

  • Eine strategische Schlüsselrolle mit hohem Impact und direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung
  • Die Möglichkeit, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen und zu formen
  • Ein sinnstiftendes Geschäftsmodell mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz
  • Dynamisches, wachstumsorientiertes Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Perspektive auf weiterführende Verantwortung im Bereich Commercial Leadership
  • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten Sie in einem dynamischen, interkulturellen Team.

title: IT-Administrator (m/w/d) (m/w/d) in Teilzeit
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ecoturn GmbH
description_html:
Wir handeln THG-Quoten und betreiben mit Elektrovorteil eine der aktiven B2C-Marken im Markt. Seit 2021haben wir mehrere hunderttausend Prämien an Halter von Elektrofahrzeugen ausgezahlt. Das Team arbeitetverteilt in Deutschland und besteht zum größten Teil aus Vertrieb, Kundensupport und einem kleinenEntwicklungsteam.

Eine eigene IT-Administration gab es bei uns bisher nicht. Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Domains und Postfächerhaben Geschäftsführung und Kollegen aus anderen Rollen nebenbei betreut. Das reicht nicht mehr: Das Teamwächst, wir haben viel E-Mail-Verkehr mit Kunden und Partnern, und Kontosicherheit und Zustellbarkeitmüssen zuverlässig funktionieren. Wir suchen deshalb eine Person, die diese Themen übernimmt, aufräumtund dann dauerhaft in Ordnung hält. Wenn du KI nicht als Buzzword, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug nutzt undlieber skriptest als klickst, passt die Rolle.

Deine Mission

Du machst unsere IT verlässlich und hältst sie ohne Handarbeit in Ordnung: Microsoft 365 und Entra ID sauberadministriert, E-Mail-Zustellbarkeit unter Kontrolle, Zugänge geordnet, und alles, was sich wiederholt, als Skriptoder KI-gestützter Ablauf statt als Checkliste.

Aufgaben

  • Aufräumen und dann Betrieb: Am Anfang gehst du Accounts und Lizenzen durch, ordnest Rollen undRechte, schließt verwaiste Postfächer, setzt MFA und Conditional Access lückenlos durch und bringst SPF,DKIM und DMARC für alle Domains in Ordnung. Danach geht es in den laufenden Betrieb.
  • Microsoft 365 und Entra ID: Benutzer, Gruppen, Lizenzen, Rollen und Rechte, Sicherheitsrichtlinien,Geräte. Dazu die Sicherheitsmeldungen aus Defender und Entra ID einordnen, darauf reagieren unddokumentieren.
  • Tenant sauber halten: Freigaben für Drittanwendungen prüfen und bereinigen, Enterprise Apps und App-Berechtigungen auf Postfächer und Daten im Blick behalten.
  • On- und Offboarding mit allen Zugängen (Microsoft, HubSpot, Atlassian, GitHub, KI-Tools und die übrigenSaaS-Dienste), als geskripteter Ablauf statt Checkliste.
  • Domains, DNS und E-Mail: Verwaltung unserer Domains, Mail-Konfiguration, Umzüge und Migrationen vonPostfächern. Zustellbarkeit und Spam-Schutz in beide Richtungen, inklusive Absenderreputation, Blacklist-Monitoring und dem Zusammenspiel mit dem Versand aus HubSpot, Mailchimp, unserer Plattform undeasybill.
  • HubSpot: Nutzer- und Rechteverwaltung und die Anbindung an Microsoft (Anmeldung, Kalender,Postfächer).
  • KI-Werkzeuge verwalten: Team-Accounts und Zugriffe (Claude, GitHub), Konnektoren und MCP-Anbindungen an Microsoft 365, HubSpot und Jira, Regeln für Datenzugriff und Datenschutz.
  • Eigene Arbeit automatisieren: Skripte und kleine Tools mit Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugenbauen, Runbooks und Dokumentation KI-gestützt aktuell halten, wiederkehrende IT-Anfragen überAssistenten abfangen.
  • Erste Anlaufstelle für IT-Fragen im Team und Koordination externer Dienstleister und Software-Anbieter.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Praxis in der Administration von Microsoft 365 und Entra ID in einem laufendenUnternehmen. Diese Stelle ist kein Einstieg in das Thema: Wir brauchen jemanden, der das schonverantwortet hat.
  • Du hast schon einmal eine Mail-Umgebung aufgesetzt oder saniert und weißt, wie SPF, DKIM und DMARCzusammenwirken und was passiert, wenn sie es nicht tun.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit DNS und Domainverwaltung.
  • Scripting mit PowerShell oder Microsoft Graph, genug, um Abläufe zu automatisieren statt sie zu klicken.
  • KI gehört zu deinem Arbeitsalltag: Du nutzt Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot oder Vergleichbares für Skripte,Analysen und Dokumentation und kannst konkret sagen, was du damit schon automatisiert hast.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du dokumentierst, was du tust, und meldest dich, bevor etwaseskaliert.
  • Klare Kommunikation auf Deutsch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die keine Techniker sind.
  • Nice to have: HubSpot oder ein vergleichbares CRM auf Admin-Seite, KI-Coding-Werkzeuge (ClaudeCode, Cursor) oder Automatisierungsplattformen (Make, Power Automate), MCP-Anbindungen und KI-Assistenten auf Unternehmensdaten, Tenant-Migrationen, Grundkenntnisse in Informationssicherheit undDatenschutz (ISO 27001, BSI-Grundschutz). Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie MS-102 oder SC-300 sindwillkommen, ersetzen aber keine Praxis.

Benefits

  • Ein Aufgabenfeld, das du selbst ordnest, mit kurzem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zumEntwicklungsteam.
  • Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht diskutiert, sondern einsetzt. Claude, Coding-Assistenten und Automatisierung sindbei uns Standardwerkzeuge, kein Pilotprojekt.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, vollständig mobiles Arbeiten, moderne Ausstattung.
  • Attraktives Gehalt und Bonusmodelle.
  • Fortbildungen, zum Beispiel Microsoft-Zertifizierungen.
  • Regelmäßige Workations mit dem gesamten Team.

Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns reden.

title: Lead Data Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Better Collective A/S
description_html:
About Better Collective

Sports media at scale, running on data

Better Collective is a global sports media group, reaching more than 400 million monthly visits across a portfolio of leading sports media brands.

We build products and experiences that make sports more engaging and accessible for fans around the world. Behind that sits a large and diverse technology and data landscape, spanning markets, brands and business models.

We work in a collaborative environment where people are encouraged to challenge how things are done, take ownership and help shape what comes next.

The domain

Paid media is where the data has to pay off.

We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut, which markets get more budget: those calls come out of the models this team builds.

Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, CRM data, all stitched into one user-level view of what a click was actually worth. That model exists and it works.

It is also the most demanding domain on our data platform - the most sources, the fastest schema churn, and the shortest patience for a table that landed late.

We are looking for the engineer who owns it.

Where this role sits

A central platform team sets the how. You set the what.

Better Collective runs a hub and spoke data organisation. A central data platform team owns the platform itself - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the golden paths, the standards, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a domain team, a spoke, that builds on it.

The split is deliberate and we hold to it. The platform team decides how data is produced here. You decide what paid media produces, and you own everything we run.

So you are not starting a new stack, and you are not going to spend your year on plumbing that a central team should be solving once for everyone.

You are, however, expected to be a demanding customer. When a golden path does not fit paid media, we want you to say so and push for it to change, not quietly build around it.

You will report to the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights and work across Paid Media, with the Campaign, Commercial and CRM teams, as well as with the central platform team.

What you will own

Every data job in paid media. All of it.

Freshness, cost, reliability, alerting, and the incident at 07:30 before the spend review. If a paid media model is wrong or late, it is yours, not the platform team's. That accountability is the core of this role, not a footnote to it.

Concretely, you will own:

  • The end-to-end user-level model. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, and CRM, joined into one view the business trusts enough to move budget on.

  • Ingestion of paid media sources, built on the platform's framework. Which sources, which schemas, and what happens the next time a network changes its API without telling anyone.

  • The domain's models, from staging through to the marts analysts and business teams actually query, plus the semantic meaning that sits on top of them. Nobody at the centre can define what a qualified signup means in paid media. You can.

  • Reverse ETL back into the ad platforms, so online and offline conversion data lands where it changes bidding.

  • The handover. Part of your first year is taking over the paid media jobs the central team still runs on our behalf, and moving that ownership to where the context actually lives.

What you will lead

A group of engineers, and the standard they build to

You will guide and mentor a group of data engineers in Paid Media Insights, as their technical lead. That means setting the standard for how this domain builds, reviewing their work, unblocking them, and deliberately growing them: giving away the interesting problems rather than keeping them.

You will also shape the domain's roadmap together with the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, the analysts and the business teams, and you will represent paid media in platform conversations, including how we support machine learning and data science on top of this data.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a step away from building. You will be in the code.


What we are looking for

More than a stack match, we are looking for a particular way of working.

You take ownership, and it shows up in the boring parts. Plenty of engineers want to design the model. You also want the pager. You would rather own a domain end to end, unglamorous parts included, than build one piece and hand off the consequences. When things get tricky, you follow through.

You break complex systems into simple parts. Paid media data is genuinely messy: attribution windows, late conversions, identity across platforms, and dozens of source APIs that all disagree. You can hold that complexity and still hand the business something they can reason about.

You raise the people around you. You are the person colleagues come to for technical advice, and you enjoy that part of the job. You give feedback that lands, you review generously, and you would rather the whole team understand the pipeline than be the only one who does.

You work well with a platform team. You have strong opinions about standards and you are still happy to work inside someone else's. You know the difference between a constraint worth fighting and a preference worth dropping, and you would rather help fix a shared path than fork it.

You are already past prompting. AI is part of how you engineer, not something you occasionally ask questions. You have experimented with agents, tooling or AI-enabled workflows, and you have a view on what a data domain has to look like for them to be useful on top of it: documented, standardised, semantically clear. Paid media is likely where we find out first.

You are close to the business. You will sit with marketers and analysts who are spending budget on what you build. You want that proximity, and you can talk about data with people who do not think in tables.

You are technically deep where it counts. Production pipelines in SQL and Python, modelling and orchestration tooling such as dbt and Dagster, cloud data warehousing, and a real feel for performance, cost and reliability at scale. Experience with paid media or attribution data, or with machine learning pipelines, is a bonus rather than a requirement.

Not sure you meet every single requirement? That is okay. Your unique experience might be exactly what we are looking for.

Our stack

What you will build on

MotherDuck / DuckDB   ·   dbt   ·   Dagster   ·   DLT   ·   Python   ·   SQL   ·   AWS   ·   reverse ETL and semantic layer tooling

We do not expect you to have worked with all of these. If you have built production pipelines on Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift and you are curious about where we are going, that transfers.

What we offer

An international company in growth, and a flat structure

Join a strong team where you can create value and make a real business impact, in a dynamic and creative environment with a flat organisational structure. Freedom with responsibility, ample room to grow, and the chance to take on a broad set of responsibilities.

Flexible working hours supporting a healthy work-life balance, private health insurance, and office perks including lunch, snacks, gym access and social events, alongside skilled, passionate and fun colleagues.

Your path to Better Collective

How to apply

We process applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For questions about the position, reach out to Michael Hill, Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, at ----- We look forward to hearing from you.
