title: ISB Informationssicherheitsbeauftragter (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at GECKO mbH
description_html:
Wir bieten Dir eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem erfolgreichen und vielseitigen Technologie-Unternehmen im Software-, IT- und Cloud-Umfeld. Teamarbeit und Enthusiasmus sind die Basis unserer Unternehmenskultur. Bei uns genießt Du eine familiäre Arbeitsatmosphäre, kurze Entscheidungswege, moderne Büros und Technik. Außerdem bieten wir Dir eine attraktive Vergütung mit unterschiedlichen Benefits und garantieren Dir einen sicheren und unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz.

Wir arbeiten mit modernen IT-Infrastruktur-, Firewall-, Datenbanksystem-, Server- und Cloud-Technologien und setzen auf einen State-of-the-Art-Technologie-Stack.

Auch wenn Du Dich beim Lesen nicht in allen Punkten wiederfindest, ist das kein Problem. Mit unseren Aus- und Weiterbildungsangeboten machen wir Dich vom Junior zum Senior. Ganz egal auf welchem Karrierelevel Du gerade bist, bewirb Dich einfach bei uns.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Rolle des Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten und entwickelst das bestehende Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystem (ISMS) gezielt weiter
  • Du begleitest unsere laufende ISO 27001 Zertifizierung, steuerst die dafür erforderlichen Maßnahmen und stellst sicher, dass die Anforderungen der Norm dauerhaft im Unternehmen verankert werden
  • Du berätst Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche zu Risiken und Maßnahmen der Informationssicherheit und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Maßnahmen für Entwicklung, Managed IT Services und Business Applications
  • Du pflegst und schärfst bestehende Richtlinien, Prozesse und Sicherheitskonzepte, überwachst deren Einhaltung und koordinierst Risikoanalysen für interne Systeme und Kundenumgebungen
  • Du stellst sicher, dass Informationssicherheit entlang des gesamten Softwareentwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesses verankert ist, z. B. durch Secure Development Practices, Härtung und Berechtigungskonzepte
  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson in Fragen der Informationssicherheit, unterstützt bei Kundenaudits sowie ISO-Audits und organisierst Schulungen und Awareness-Maßnahmen für Mitarbeitende

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung beim Aufbau, Betrieb oder der Zertifizierung eines ISMS nach ISO 27001
  • Idealerweise zusätzliche Kenntnisse weiterer Standards und Frameworks (z. B. BSI-Grundschutz, OWASP, NIST)
  • Gutes Verständnis von IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken, Cloud-Umgebungen und Softwareentwicklungsprozessen
  • Idealerweise Zertifizierungen im Umfeld Informationssicherheit (z. B. ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CISM, CISSP o. ä.)
  • Kenntnisse relevanter rechtlicher Rahmenbedingungen, insbesondere DSGVO und Anforderungen an Auftragsverarbeitung
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht zu kommunizieren
  • Hohe Beratungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz und Freude daran, Informationssicherheit im Unternehmen aktiv voranzutreiben

Benefits

  • Du willst Dich Details widmen und nachhaltig Probleme lösen?
  • Du willst Dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln und neue Wege gehen?
  • Du willst wirklich etwas verändern und hohe eigene Qualitätsansprüche umsetzen?
  • Du willst flexible Arbeitszeiten und auch im Homeoffice arbeiten?
  • Du willst eine unbefristete Festeinstellung?

Bei GECKO suchen wir Menschen mit Leidenschaft und Engagement, um in den kommenden Jahren weiter wachsen zu können. Im Gegenzug sind wir gern bereit in unsere Mitarbeiter zu investieren, sowohl bei der Arbeit als auch im täglichen Leben.

Bleib flexibel

Uns ist es nicht wichtig, dass du zu einem festen Zeitpunkt im Büro sitzt. Wir wissen, dass Mitarbeiter am produktivsten sind, wenn sie ihre Arbeitsroutine in Einklang mit dem Privatleben bringen können. Ob im Büro oder im Home Office, bei uns kannst du dir den Tag mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten so einteilen, dass er zu deinem Leben passt. Dabei unterstützen wir dich mit modernen Kommunikationstools und einer transparenten Arbeitsplanung.

Bleib fit

Kennst du das auch? Du steckst gerade mitten im Workflow und ein kleines Hungergefühl stellt sich ein. Dafür haben wir vorgesorgt und stellen kostenlos frisches Obst in den Büros bereit und sorgen mit Getränken, wie z.B. Wasser, Kaffee und Mate dafür, dass auch das Trinken nicht zu kurz kommt. So kannst du dich jederzeit stärken und schon geht’s motiviert weiter.

Empfehle und profitiere

Wir sind ständig auf der Suche nach Talenten, die Teil unseres Teams werden möchten. Für Mitarbeiter, die überzeugt sind den perfekten Kandidaten zu kennen, der uns beim Wachsen unterstützen kann und der gut zu uns passt, zahlen wir bei Übernahme eines empfohlenen Mitarbeiters eine Prämie, die sich sehen lassen kann.

Arbeiten und Spaß haben

Wer fleißig gearbeitet hat, darf sich natürlich auch belohnen. In den Pausen oder nach Feierabend kannst du dich gern bei uns in den Chillout Areas zum Quatschen mit den Kollegen treffen oder beim Zocken an der Playstation antreten. Team-Events und Mitarbeiterfrühstück gehören bei uns genauso dazu, wie der kleine Plausch in der Küche, denn stärken wir das Wir-Gefühl und wachsen weiter zusammen.

Um für die täglichen Herausforderungen gewappnet zu sein und den Geschäftserfolg nachhaltig zu stärken, glauben wir nicht nur an Expertise und Erfahrung. Wir glauben vor allem auch an den Zusammenhalt unserer Teams und an eine Kultur, die Respekt, Toleranz und ein faires Miteinander fördert. Wenn du ähnlich tickst wie wir, sind wir schon jetzt sehr gespannt darauf dich kennenzulernen.

description_html:
HELFERLINE ist die führende Technik-Support-Plattform im DACH-Raum. Seit 2016 helfen wir jährlich tausenden Privatkunden bei technischen Problemen, gemeinsam mit Partnern wie MediaMarkt, O₂ und Starlink. Besonders stark wachsen wir im Bereich Satelliten-Internet, und dafür suchen wir Installateur:innen.

Aufgaben

Du installierst Starlink-Kits bei Privatkunden vor Ort. Das umfasst:

  • Idealen Aufstellort mit der Starlink-App bestimmen
  • Einfachste LAN-Kabelführung ins Haus ermitteln und mit dem Kunden abstimmen (ggf. Bohrungen nötig)
  • Router über das mitgelieferte LAN-Kabel anschließen
  • Installation Schritt für Schritt in der App durchführen
  • Vor- und Nachherfotos hochladen
  • Abschließenden Speedtest durchführen

Wünscht der Kunde vor Ort zusätzliche Leistungen – z.B. die Verbindung seiner Endgeräte mit dem neuen Router – so kannst Du diese zusätzlich verrechnen und erhöhst Deinen Verdienst pro Einsatz.

Qualifikation

  • Handwerkliches Geschick – Erfahrung mit Antennenmontage oder ähnlichem ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Smartphone
  • Eigenes Werkzeug, Leiter und Schutzausrüstung
  • Pünktlichkeit und ein freundliches Auftreten gegenüber Kunden
  • Einen Gewerbeschein – oder die Bereitschaft, einen anzumelden (einfach und günstig, wir erklären dir, wie)

Benefits

  • Kostenlose Starlink-Zertifizierung – Online-Schulung, in ca. 2 Stunden abgeschlossen; danach bist du offiziell von Starlink zertifiziert
  • 100 € Pauschale pro abgeschlossenem Auftrag + Anfahrtskosten (je nach Region) + ggf. Zusatzhonorar bei Sonderwünschen
  • Du entscheidest selbst, welche Aufträge du annimmst und wann – keine Mindestverpflichtung, keine Bindung
  • Weitere Aufträge über die HELFERLINE-App möglich (Mindestlohn 40 €/h)

Klingt nicht schlecht? Bewirb Dich jetzt!

title: Data Engineer (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Good Hood GmbH / nebenan.de
description_html:
Your mission

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our Information and AI Platform and own our data pipelines end to end — from data modeling to experimentation to production.

  • Own our pipelines end-to-end, from stakeholder metric definition through dbt modeling, QA, and A/B testing, to Dagster scheduling and production.
  • Move us from people asking for reports to a system that answers — self-service for coworkers, reliable answers for AI agents, a self-describing warehouse.
  • Keep our steering metrics real and trusted as governed metrics-as-code.
  • Run the relevance and content pipelines that keep the platform a reflection of real life.
  • Work closely with Product, engineering, and other stakeholders to translate their data needs into models that hold up in production.
  • Keep our data governance in good shape in terms of quality, security, and compliance.
  • Work with the team to improve personalized recommendations and other ML algorithms.

Our stack: dbt, Snowflake, MotherDuck, Dagster, SQL, Python, AWS, GitHub Actions, Docker, VS Code

Your profile

Must-haves

  • Experience in a data engineering role or similar, with a solid understanding of data warehousing and ETL concepts.
  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience running dbt models in production.
  • Experience with an orchestration tool — we use Dagster.
  • You've built and run data or information infrastructure that other teams depend on.
  • You're comfortable working directly with backend and infrastructure engineers as well as non-technical stakeholders, and can translate between the two.
  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally Snowflake, and a cloud provider, ideally AWS.
  • You're comfortable with version control, ideally Git.
  • You have experience working with AI coding tools like Claude Code, and know how to use them to move faster without cutting corners.
  • You're sound on GDPR and Article 9 in practice — you know how to design compliant data access for both people and agents.

Nice-to-haves

  • You've taken a ranking or recommendation pipeline through to production.
  • You know your way around ML concepts — you don't need to build models yourself, but understanding the basics helps you work well with our ML engineers.
  • You have experience or are interested in working with data agents and making them reliable.
  • You're fluent in modern data and AI tooling and agentic systems, and understand why curation and semantic context decide whether agents can be trusted.
  • You've led or mentored other engineers, or you're ready to grow into that, with support from our Leadership & Coaching guild.

And you're the kind of person who...

  • Communicates clearly, and can explain complex data concepts to technical and non-technical people alike.
  • Keeps up with new tools and trends in the field, and likes sharing what they learn with the team.
  • Values diversity, collaboration, and inclusion, and helps build a team where everyone feels welcome.
  • Is a systems builder at heart — energized by building what makes everyone else faster and more certain, not by owning a queue.
  • Takes ownership of unsolved problems, like safe AI access to information, rather than waiting for someone else to solve them.

What we offer

  • A hybrid work model that combines at least 2 office days and remote work
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation
  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute
  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice
  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical

If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

title: Support Engineer Firewall & Netzwerk (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Medialine EuroTrade AG
description_html:
Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft Medialine EuroTrade AG zu besetzen.

Du möchtest Firewalls und Netzwerke nicht nur bedienen, sondern wirklich verstehen?

Bei uns bist Du nicht der Generalist für alles, sondern entwickelst Dich gezielt im Bereich Firewall und Netzwerk weiter. Du analysierst Störungen, konfigurierst Firewalls, Switches und Access Points und betreust Netzwerkumgebungen unterschiedlicher Kunden. Dadurch sammelst Du in kurzer Zeit deutlich mehr praktische Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Herstellern und Umgebungen als in einer klassischen Inhouse-IT.

Als Teil unseres Support-Teams bist Du Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen, unterstützt unseren Service Desk bei tiefergehenden Fragen und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Support Engineers zusammen. Du musst noch kein Netzwerk-Profi sein – erste praktische Erfahrung reicht. Wir bauen Dein Wissen gemeinsam durch Einarbeitung, Wissenstransfer und Herstellerzertifizierungen aus.

Aufgaben

  • Annahme, Analyse und Bearbeitung von Störungen und Anfragen im Bereich Netzwerk und Firewall per Telefon, E-Mail und Ticketsystem
  • Konfiguration und Betreuung von Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall, Fortinet FortiGate) – Regelwerke, NAT, VPN
  • Administration von Netzwerkkomponenten wie Switches und Access Points (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi, Fortinet oder Sophos)
  • Einrichtung und Support von Site-to-Site- und Client-VPN-Verbindungen
  • Analyse von Netzwerkproblemen (DNS, DHCP, VLAN, Routing) gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden
  • Dokumentation von Konfigurationen, Änderungen und Lösungen
  • Unterstützung unseres Service Desks als fachlicher Ansprechpartner für Netzwerk- und Firewall-Themen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Support Engineers bei komplexeren Themen und Projekten
  • arbeiten nach definierten Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker/in Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
  • Berufserfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder in der Systemadministration
  • Grundverständnis von Netzwerken (TCP/IP, VLAN, Routing, DNS, DHCP)
  • erste praktische Erfahrung mit Firewalls (z. B. Sophos Firewall oder Fortinet FortiGate) und/oder Netzwerkkomponenten (z. B. Ubiquiti UniFi)
  • gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Windows Client-Betriebssystemen
  • Freude an der Analyse technischer Probleme und Interesse, Dich im Netzwerk- und Security-Umfeld zu spezialisieren
  • Service- und kundenorientiertes Denken
  • selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Systemhaus- oder MSP-Umfeld
  • Kenntnisse in Sophos Central, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer oder UniFi Network Controller
  • Herstellerzertifizierungen (z. B. Sophos Certified Engineer, Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA)
  • Grundkenntnisse in Windows-Server-Umgebungen, Active Directory oder Microsoft 365
  • erste Berührungspunkte mit Virtualisierung (Hyper-V oder VMware)
  • ITIL-Kenntnisse oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

Das erwartet Dich

  • ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen Kunden, Herstellern und Netzwerkumgebungen
  • gezielte fachliche Spezialisierung im Bereich Firewall, Netzwerk und IT-Security
  • strukturierte Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
  • geförderte individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten z.B. bei Sophos und Fortinet
  • Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung System Engineering Netzwerk & Security

Weitere Benefits, je nach Standort und Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Mitarbeiterevents
  • Weiterbildung
  • subventioniertes Mittagessen
  • Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
  • Mentorenprogramm
  • Warm- und Kaltgetränke
  • Obstkorb
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • Fahrtkostenerstattung
  • Firmenwagen
  • Job-Fahrrad
  • Parkplatz
  • flexible Arbeitszeit
  • Sportangebot
  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Job-Ticket
  • Notebook und Smartphone
  • Workation

title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at UP42 GmbH
description_html:
UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group.

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy.
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do:

  • Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them.

  • Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first.

  • Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path.

  • Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work.

  • Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one.

  • Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning.

  • Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them.

  • Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked.


Here is a good summary of what we are looking for:

  • Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team.

  • Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable.

  • Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it.

  • Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method.

  • Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction.

  • Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see.

  • Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability.

Bonus points if you bring:

  • Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products.

  • Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.

  • Experience with interactive prototyping.

  • Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity.

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice:

  • Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective

  • Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year

  • Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment

  • Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few

  • Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year

  • Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English.

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.

description_html:
Als Senior SAP (IS-U oder FI/CO) ABAP Application Developer – Produktentwicklung (m/w/d) gestaltest du die Zukunft unserer Produktfamilie und Transformationsplattform Natuvion DCS (Data Conversion Suite) im Bereich Content. Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zur unserem Projektgeschäft im Bereich Datentransformation und -migration als auch unseren Partnern.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du arbeitest aktiv mit am Design, der Entwicklungen sowie Erweiterungen unserer Services im Bereich DCS Migrate Content.

description_html:
As a Senior Client Executive Public Sector Germany (m/f/d), you will be responsible for driving the growth and expansion of our business within the German public sector. You will acquire new clients, develop strategic relationships, and lead complex sales opportunities from initial engagement through to contract signature. Working closely with internal experts, you will shape our market strategy and create the foundation for sustainable growth in the German public sector.

Business Development Public Sector

  • Develop and execute the sales and go-to-market strategy to drive sustainable growth of our public sector business in Germany.

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop target customers, market opportunities, and strategic accounts while building a long-term sales pipeline.

  • Analyze market, technology, and regulatory trends and derive targeted sales initiatives in collaboration with marketing, partners, and internal experts.

Strategic Account & Client Management

  • Build and expand strategic client relationships and develop long-term partnerships.

  • Establish trusted relationships with stakeholders across business, IT, procurement, and executive levels while understanding decision-making structures.

  • Develop and execute account plans and drive cross-sell, upsell, and growth opportunities by positioning our service and solution portfolio.

Network Development

  • Build and maintain a strong network of public sector stakeholders, decision-makers, partners, and industry influencers.

  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking forums to strengthen market presence and expand market access.

  • Leverage structured stakeholder management to identify new opportunities, strategic initiatives, and future business potential at an early stage.

Opportunity Development & Sales Ownership

  • Identify, qualify, and strategically develop complex sales opportunities with clear deal, win, and closing strategies.

  • Own opportunities end-to-end across the entire sales cycle, from needs assessment through contract award.

  • Manage pipeline, forecasting, and closing activities, including risk, stakeholder, and decision-management processes.

Public Procurement & Tender Management

  • Identify, assess, and strategically manage public tenders, procurement procedures, and framework agreements.

  • Develop winning bid, positioning, and partnering strategies in collaboration with Bid Management, Solution Experts, and external partners.

  • Ensure strong competitive positioning through differentiation, negotiation, and effective management of procurement opportunities.

Consultative & Value Selling

  • Analyze the strategic, organizational, and technological requirements of public sector clients and translate them into business and transformation opportunities.

  • Develop and position compelling value propositions that connect business value, technical solutions, and commercial models.

  • Lead executive-level customer engagements and communicate effectively with business leaders, CIO organizations, procurement teams, and management.

  • Own the commercial deal and negotiation strategy to achieve successful business outcomes.


  • Several years of successful experience in B2B and/or B2G sales

  • Ideally 7+ years of relevant professional experience in Enterprise Sales, Account Management, Business Development, or comparable roles

  • Several years of experience within the German public sector

  • Proven track record in building and developing strategic customer relationships

  • Demonstrated success in managing complex and long-term sales cycles

  • Ideally experience in the SAP and/or ERP environment, or with cloud and software solutions

  • Experience with public tenders, procurement procedures, and bidding processes

  • Strong understanding of the German public-sector market, including the structures and decision-making processes of public-sector organizations and authorities.

If you think that you don't meet all the requirements: With us, there are "no limits" to your development! Go your way with us - we support you! Just show us who you are.

What you can expect from us:

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable:

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion is a digital moving company.

Our team does not move tables, filing cabinets or chairs. Natuvion transports business-critical data and processes from one technology platform to another. Typical Natuvion "relocation services" include data migration, data transformation, data integration, data privacy, data security, and data quality.

Our >400 consultants and developers in Germany, Austria, Slovakia, the USA and Australia have extensive know-how in (SAP)® projects and a profound understanding of processes across industry boundaries. With a lot of experience, commitment and commitment, they support our customers with advice, services and their own software technology. In this way, we enable companies to always use their data and processes on the most modern and innovative platforms.

title: Project Associate - Climate Analytics (PSA-3)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at United Nations University
description_html:
United Nations University (UNU)

The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States.

 

For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu

 

The United Nations University’s Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS) was established in 2003 in Bonn, Germany. The institute conducts research work focusing on advancing human security and well-being by addressing present and future risks arising from environmental hazards and climate change. Its main areas of work are risk & adaptation and transformation. In addition to its research work, UNU-EH offers education opportunities at the master’s level and hosts a number of international PhD projects and capacity-development courses on global issues of environmental risks and sustainable development. More information about UNU-EHS can be found here: https://unu.edu/ehs.

 

The Munich Climate Insurance Initiative (MCII) is hosted at UNU-EHS and is a research-to-policy and practice innovation lab. MCII aims to support and ultimately influence policy making processes that enhance resilience and protect livelihoods of vulnerable communities, through pioneering risk management and risk transfer solutions (e.g. insurance mechanisms) in combination with other approaches to manage climate related risks. For detailed information, please visit: https://ehs.unu.edu/about/departments/the-munich-climate-insurance-initiative-mcii#overview.

Climate Risk Analytics: The Climate Risk Analytics team manages a portfolio of MCII projects that use quantitative methods to improve understanding of climate risk and inform decision making. The main goals for strategic impact are i) to establish analytics to support decisions in adaptation and risk management, ii) to define the “smart mix” of climate response options, including climate risk insurance and to iii) further operational concepts of improved climate risk management also through academic collaborations.

Responsibilities

Under the authority of the Director of UNU-EHS, the guidance of the Chief Climate Risk Strategist and Head of the MCII Division, the successful candidate will be entrusted with the following tasks:

1.     Research, Analysis and Biofincas Project Deliverables

  • Conduct desk research, literature reviews, mapping exercises and data collection on topics relevant to Biofincas project activities and outputs;

  • Compile, review and analyse relevant qualitative and quantitative information, and contribute analytical or technical inputs under guidance;

  • Contribute to the drafting, editing and preparation of reports, research outputs and other project deliverables.

  • Prepare graphics, maps, and other visual materials;

  • Support the adaptation of serious games for capacity-building activities.

 

2.     Project Implementation, Coordination and Progress Tracking

  • Support the tracking and follow-up of assigned Biofincas activities under project components, consortium platforms and in line with agreed workplans, timelines and project requirements;

  • Participate in meetings with project partners and consortium members and document outstanding actions, key decisions and follow-up requirements;

 

3.     Workshops, Capacity Building and Stakeholder Engagement activities for Biofincas

  • Support the administrative and logistical preparation and coordination of workshops, meetings, capacity-building activities and stakeholder events;

  • Support the preparation of background materials, agendas, presentations, summaries for stakeholder engagement activities and any other materials required for meetings and events;

  • Maintain stakeholder contact lists, meeting records, and related project documentation;

  • Support routine communication with project partners, technical experts, government counterparts, research institutions and other stakeholders.

 

4.     Project acquisition and Proposal Development Activities

  • Identify and screen relevant funding opportunities and call for proposals aligned with the established areas of work;

  • Assist in the preparation and drafting of selected sections of project proposals and other funding-related materials;

  • Support communication and follow-up with donors and relevant counterparts regarding requirements, processes and application procedures.

 

5.     Cross-cutting Thematic Support

  • Contribute to activities related to cross-cutting themes including gender, agriculture, and climate across Biofincas project components;

  • Support the integration of relevant themes into research outputs, analysis, and project activities and deliverables;

  • Contribute to activities aligned with the gender strategy of the section and the institute.

 

6. Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor(s)

Key Performance Indicators

  • Timely and high-quality development of inputs related to the climate analytics team effort.

  • High quality and level of engagement with project implementation partners.

  • Effective tracking and follow-up of projects activities, decisions and agreed action points.

  • Quality and relevance of contributions of inputs from project partners and other stakeholder.

  • Maintain strong stakeholder relationships and a high level of trust in UNU-EHS/MCII among research partners, governments, donors, and civil society.

Competencies

Values:

  • Inclusion - Take action to create an environment of dignity and respect for all, regardless of age, culture, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, geography, grade, language, nationality, racial identity, religion, sex, sex characteristics, sexual orientation, social origin or any other aspect of identity;

  • Integrity - Act ethically, demonstrating the standards of conduct of the United Nations and taking prompt action in case of witnessing unprofessional or unethical behaviour, or any other breach of UN standards;

  • Humility - Demonstrate self-awareness and willingness to learn from others;

  • Humanity - Act according to the purposes of the United Nations: peace, dignity and equality on a healthy planet.

Behaviours:

  • Connect and Collaborate - Build positive relationships with others to advance the work of the United Nations and work coherently as One UN;

  • Analyse and Plan - Seek out and use data from a wide range of sources to understand problems, inform decision-making, propose evidence-based solutions and plan action;

  • Deliver Results with Positive Impact - Hold oneself and others accountable for delivering results and making a positive difference to the people and causes that the United Nations serves;

  • Learn and Develop - Pursue own learning and development and contribute to the learning and development of others;

  • Adapt and Innovate - Demonstrate flexibility, agility and the ability to think and act in novel ways.



1) Education and certification

MSc degree or equivalent in environmental sciences, natural resource management, environmental engineering, geography, ecology, or a related field.

2) Required qualifications and experience      

  • Solid understanding of disaster risk reduction and management, and climate change adaptation, and related issues

  • Strong ability to conduct desk research, literature reviews, data collection and qualitative and quantitative analysis and to synthesize information technical reports and project deliverables.

  • Proven experience supporting workshops, meetings, capacity-building activities and stakeholder engagement, including logistical and administrative tasks.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, organizational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and external partners.

3) Desired qualifications and experience

  • At least one (1) year of progressively responsible experience in supporting project coordination, preferably in an international setting.

  • Experience with programming, GIS tools for spatial analysis, data visualization and CLIMADA/ECA is an asset.

  • Experience contributing to technical reports, research outputs, project proposals, or donor reporting is an asset.

  • Work experience in developing countries is an asset.

4) Language Requirements:

  • Fluency in English and Spanish is required.

  • Knowledge of German is an asset;

  • Knowledge of another UN official working language is an asset.


Remuneration

The successful candidate will be employed under a national PSA contract. UNU offers an attractive compensation package including an annual net salary, commensurate with the experience and qualifications of the candidate. Benefits include 30 days annual leave and a health insurance scheme.

UNU is not liable for any taxes that may be levied on the remuneration you receive under this contract. Payment of any such taxes remains the sole responsibility of PSA holders.


Duration of contract

The duration of the initial contract is 1 year. This is Personnel Service Agreement (PSA) contract with UNU, with the possibility for renewal subject to requirements and satisfactory work performance. The combined duration on a PSA contract with UNU may not exceed six (6) years. The mandatory age of retirement for PSA holders is 65 years.  This post is open to applicants from all countries and UNU will aid the
successful applicant in securing a work visa for Germany, as necessary. It is, however, a locally recruited post and no relocation allowances
apply. The duty station will be Bonn, Germany.


Starting date: As soon as possible

Submissions must be received by 23:59 CET on the deadline; late entries will not be accepted.


How to Apply

To apply to UNU, you will not need an account. Instead, we ask that you:

  • Fill out the UNU P11 Form (please avoid using similar forms provided by other United Nations organisations);

  • provide a motivation statement (in the P11 form);

  • provide a cover letter setting out how the qualifications and experience match the requirements of the position;

  • answer a few questions that are tailored to the position; and

    You may wish to refer to the UN Values and Behaviours Framework for more information.

  • apply via the apply link.


Application Deadline: 08 October 2026.

Submissions must be received by 23:59 CET on the deadline; late entries will not be accepted.


Assessment

Evaluation of qualified candidates may include an assessment exercise which may be followed by a competency-based interview, background checks, and references.


Special Notice

PSA holders are neither “staff members” under the Staff Regulations and Rules of the United Nations nor “officials” for the purpose of the Convention on the Privileges and Immunities of the United Nations (1946). They are subject to the Rector's authority and may be assigned to any of the activities or offices of the United Nations University. The Rector reserves the right to appoint a candidate at a level below that advertised. UNU is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce, and encourages all candidates, irrespective of gender, nationality, religious and ethnic backgrounds, including persons living with disabilities to apply and become part of the organisation. Applications from developing countries, and from women are strongly encouraged. Eligible internal applicants are also encouraged to apply. UNU has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNU, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. If you have supervisory function, you need to have awareness on gender related issues.


Information about UNU rosters

UNU reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNU at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.


Scam Warning

UNU does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

title: Mid-level/Senior Account Manager (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Fraser Gmbh
description_html:
Your role

At FRASER, we combine strategy, creativity and technology to build impactful work for ambitious brands. 

We are looking for a German-speaking Mid–level/Senior Account Manager to join our Account Management team and take ownership of client relationships and projects from briefing through to delivery. 

You’ll be the link between our clients and internal teams, ensuring work is well briefed, organised and delivered to a high standard. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Own day-to-day relationships with assigned clients and act as their main point of contact.
  • Lead projects and campaigns from briefing to delivery. 
  • Translate client needs into clear briefs for creative, strategy and production teams.
  • Coordinate internal teams over different locations, timelines, budgets and deliverables.
  • Manage client feedback, expectations and approvals.
  • Prepare and lead client meetings, status updates and presentations.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen client relationships and grow existing accounts.
  • Support pitches, new business and account strategies.
  • Proactively identify risks and find solutions to keep projects on track. 
  • Work closely with Account Directors and senior leadership on key accounts.


Your profile

  • 3–6+ years of experience in account management, client services or a similar role, ideally in a creative, digital or advertising agency. 
  • Proven experience managing clients and projects independently. 
  • Strong understanding of creative agency workflows. 
  • Excellent communication, presentation and organisational skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. 
  • Openness to work in an international, multicultural environment 
  • Confident, proactive and solution-oriented approach.
  • Commercial awareness and understanding of budgets and scope. 
  • Fluent (C1-C2) in German and English.


What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape a globally relevant social media arm of a growing agency with relevant big clients and substantial business 
  • A senior leadership team that is close and passionately ambitious  
  • Fantastic colleagues and a collaborative environment
  • Competitive salary 
  • Employee benefits program 
  • Chance to help shape the agency and influence its growth 
  • Flat hierarchy fostering a transparent and collaborative work culture 
  • International environment with diverse employees, clients, and locations 
  • Experienced team: work alongside seasoned professionals 
  • 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) 
  • Opportunity for workation from European countries or South Africa 
  • Flexible working hours and locations, including 3 days on site in our great office and 2 home office 
  • A great roof terrace in the heart of Kreuzberg and always a fridge full of cool drinks

title: Product Manager - EXOtube
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Exolaunch
description_html:
Introduction

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across 48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube. Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects, becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand.

Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany. The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward.


Your mission

  • Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects.

  • Lead communication with customers and ensure a fluent progression of the project.

  • Help develop concepts for Ground Support Equipment and test hardware and coordinate with suppliers.

  • Plan and participate in test and launch campaigns internationally.

  • Create and maintain documentation incl. User Manuals, Sales materials, technical reports and internal and external procedures.

  • Work hand-in-hand with the Sales team to answer prospect’s questions regarding Exolaunch’s capabilities and services, including EXOtube’s compatibility with different launch vehicles and other Exolaunch products.

  • Solidify and expand upon Exolaunch’s commitment to customer care and service excellence.

  • Write proposals alongside the business team to bid for the hardware development and launch of satellite constellations.

  • Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level

  • Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities.


Your profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in structural, mechanical or space engineering or a similar field.

  • 5+ years of engineering work experience.

  • Experience in customer-facing work and sales work.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Excellent technical communication skills.

  • Strong experience in working with CAD software such as SolidWorks.

  • Strong sense of style and form to be able to integrate Exolaunch style into documentation and hardware design.

  • Positive attitude and ability to work in a highly integrated team setting.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and demanding environment.

  • Flexibility for travel, occasionally at short notice


Why us?

  • Competitive compensation package tailored to your experience and responsibilities

  • Subsidies for lunch, mobility, and special occasions, depending on eligibility

  • Flexible working hours and a friendly, collaborative atmosphere

  • State-of-the-art Office in the heart of Berlin at Potsdamer Platz

  • Access to an in-house gym at the HQ

  • All necessary IT equipment and office tools to perform your role effectively

  • Complimentary drinks, snacks, and fresh fruit, plus a well-equipped office environment

  • Regular team gatherings, celebrations, and internal events


Travel Expectations

The position requires flexibility for regular travel, including short-notice trips. You should be comfortable with traveling approximately at 10-15% of your work time.


Location Requirement

This role is based in Berlin. Candidates must either currently reside in Berlin or be open to relocating.

title: Marketing Director (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Exolaunch
description_html:
Introduction

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you.

Exolaunch, headquartered in Berlin, Germany with offices in the U.S., France, and Japan, is a global leader in launch mission integration and deployment technologies for small satellites. With a decade of flight heritage and over 841 satellites launched across 49 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. Exolaunch fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.


Brand presence and consistent messaging are essential enablers of our success.  As the Marketing Director (m/w/d) at Exolaunch, you will serve as a core strategic leader driving our global marketing, brand presence, and multi-channel social media accounts, while exercising hands-on ownership of our public image, press relations, and executive communications.


We’re looking for a visionary marketing leader and creative storyteller with deep expertise in luxury branding, premium positioning, and high-impact copywriting. The ideal candidate brings an exceptional grasp of brand strategy and global communications, capable of converting complex technical achievements into compelling narratives for industry leaders, partners, and international media. As a senior strategist, you will lead brand governance, steer cross-functional marketing initiatives, and oversee data-driven performance analytics. You will be expected to quantify Return on Investment and Return on Effort across all campaigns to ensure Exolaunch remains top-of-mind in our industry. You will lead a small but powerful and passionate internal communications team and manage external PR agencies and advisors as needed.


Strategic Marketing & Brand Leadership:

You will define and execute our end-to-end global marketing strategy, ensuring consistency of brand identity across digital platforms and industry events. Your mission

title: Full Stack Developer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bookboost
description_html:
Your mission

Bookboost is the Hospitality Engagement Platform that empowers hotels to understand and engage their guests like never before. We unify guest data, automate personalised communication, and deliver experiences that drive revenue, loyalty, and operational excellence.

We have customers across more than 20 countries and a platform that wins on depth. We're now looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help us build the next stage of it.

Tech stack: Angular | TypeScript | Node.js | Cloudflare Workers | AWS | PostgreSQL | Terraform


Your profile

As a Full Stack Engineer you build and maintain the systems behind our platform: real-time data processing, the APIs that hold it together, and the experience our customers use every day.

The job is shifting from writing syntax to designing systems. We want engineers who are architects: people who define the right abstractions, shape the right interfaces, and make decisions that hold up six months later. Agents write a growing share of the code. Your value is in orchestrating intent, context and execution.

You would be joining a small engineering team with real latitude on technical direction. This is not a seat implementing someone else's design. If you want to be handed tickets and left alone, this is not that job. If you want a say in how the platform is built, it is a good one.

What you'll own and deliver

  • Scalable, high-performance applications across the stack
  • Frontend applications in Angular, with genuine attention to responsiveness and user experience
  • APIs designed with the rest of the team, focused on event-driven architecture and real-time data
  • Edge computing work using Cloudflare Workers, improving performance and deployment efficiency
  • Migration of services to edge runtimes, improving scalability and reducing latency
  • Architectural decisions that outlive the tickets that prompted them
  • Cross-functional work with design, product and Operations on what customers actually need
What makes you a great fit?
  • Full stack depth: 4+ years with modern frontend and backend technologies, and production systems you have owned rather than contributed to
  • Backend: strong in Node.js or another JavaScript runtime, and TypeScript. PHP and Laravel are a plus, not a requirement.
  • Data: relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimisation
  • Frontend: modern frameworks, particularly Angular
  • Edge: familiarity with Cloudflare Workers and services such as Durable Objects, KV and Workflows, or other edge runtimes
  • Cloud: understanding of cloud architecture, particularly AWS
  • AI fluency: our engineering team runs on an AI-native stack. You write code and documentation with AI tools and can talk concretely about how that has changed the way you work. This is a genuine requirement, not a bonus line.
  • Systems thinking: root cause over band-aids, patterns over one-offs. You would rather fix the shape of a problem than patch it again.
  • Craft: you care about reliability, observability, testability and documentation
  • Language: fluent English. Swedish is not required.
What's in it for you?
  • Remote and flexible working, from home or one of our hubs
  • Real influence over technical direction at a company still deciding
  • An engineering team building new ways of working with AI rather than bolting it on
  • An environment that values your judgement, with real room for impact
  • Regular team events and socials


Why us?

Bookboost gives hotel groups ownership of their guest relationships. We unify guest data across the PMS, booking engine and every communication channel, then orchestrate the guest journey pre-stay, in-stay and post-stay. Based in Malmö, Sweden, with hubs in Amsterdam and Barcelona, we work in a hybrid, remote-friendly way. Diversity and innovation go hand in hand, and we are committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Everyone is welcome at Bookboost
We value individuality and creativity, and we are building a team that reflects the world we serve. If you are passionate about making a difference, apply even if you do not meet every criterion.

Ready to join us?
Send us your application today. We interview on a rolling basis, so apply early.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Probis Software Gmbh
description_html:
Who we are

PROBIS Software GmbH is a dynamic PropTech start-up specializing in advanced cloud-based solutions for cost management processes in the real estate industry. Our flagship platform, PROBIS, delivers comprehensive financial project controlling across all project types and asset classes. From initial planning to completion, we provide leading international project developers, managers, and financial institutions with a flexible and powerful controlling tool that streamlines their operations.
We're looking for an experienced Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to own and shape the infrastructure behind PROBIS. This isn't a role where you execute someone else's blueprint: you'll have real influence over our architecture, our tool choices, and how we run Kubernetes, identity, and observability at scale working directly with our engineering leadership rather than through layers of process.


Your mission

Your Stack
Azure  ·  Kubernetes  ·  Pulumi (TypeScript) & Terraform  ·  Docker  ·  Keycloak  ·  Cloudflare & Nginx  ·  Grafana, Azure Monitor & Mezmo  ·  GitOps  ·  React & .NET

Your Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Cloud Architecture
    • Maintain and optimize our Azure-hosted Kubernetes clusters
    • Implement and refine Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi with TypeScript and Terraform
    • Design robust, scalable cloud architectures aligned with business requirements
    • Ensure smooth and reliable deployment processes, and implement build/deployment strategies that improve application performance (frontend and backend)
    • Monitor and optimize the performance of our microservices architecture
  • Identity & Access Management
    • Deploy, configure, and maintain Keycloak instances across environments
    • Implement federation with external Identity Providers
    • Configure and optimize SAML, OIDC, and OAuth2 authentication flows
    • Manage user federation, role mappings, and client configurations
    • Design and maintain custom authentication flows when required
  • Data Integration & AI Services
    • Implement and maintain ETL pipelines for our own and external data warehouses
    • Configure and optimize text extraction tools for document processing
    • Design and deploy middleware connectors for external API integration
    • Support AI service deployment and integration within our application stack
    • Ensure secure and efficient data flow between systems
  • Security
    • Establish and maintain our custom identity management system
    • Implement and enforce security best practices across the infrastructure
    • Configure and optimize network security with Cloudflare and Nginx
  • Observability & Reliability
    • Enhance monitoring capabilities using Grafana, Azure Monitor, Mezmo, Lens and other logging/monitoring tools
    • Implement proactive alerting and incident response protocols
    • Optimize log management and analysis
  • Collaboration & Technical Leadership
    • Work closely with out development teams
    • Provide technical guidance and support to the engineering organization
    • Contribute directly to architectural decisions and technology selection you help set the direction, not just follow it


Your profile

  • Must-Have
    • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure
    • Extensive hands-on experience building Infrastructure as Code, ideally with Pulumi/TypeScript and/or Terraform
    • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production environments
    • Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines
    • Strong understanding of GitOps principles and modern Git workflows
    • Strong analytical thinking, self-motivated and comfortable working independently
    • Excellent communication skills in English
  • Nice-to-Have (a strong plus, not a dealbreaker)
    • Hands-on experience with Keycloak or another identity/access management platform, and familiarity with SAML, OIDC, and OAuth2
    • Practical knowledge of microservices architecture and service mesh technologies
    • Experience with data warehouse ETL processes and middleware integration
    • Familiarity with the React ecosystem and modern build tools (e.g. RSPack/RSBuild), or with .NET package optimization and deployment
    • Curiosity about AI service integration and text extraction tooling
    • Ability to optimize cloud resources for performance and cost-efficiency
    • Microsoft Azure certifications (or willingness to obtain them)
  • Also Valued
    • Either a Master's degree in IT/Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
    • Fast learner with curiosity about emerging technologies
    • Solution-oriented approach to challenges


Why us?

  • Real ownership: you help shape our architecture and tool choices, not just execute a fixed roadmap
  • A modern, no-legacy stack Kubernetes, Pulumi/Terraform, Keycloak, and cloud-native tooling from day one
  • Full access to our comprehensive toolset (1Password, Slack, Dropbox, Notion, Azure, Git, Docker, etc.)
  • Flexible remote work options with home office capability
  • International, team-oriented atmosphere with flat hierarchies
  • Culture of open feedback and quick decision-making processes
  • Regular team and company events
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing PropTech company
  • Highly professional, high-skilled senior developers as your colleagues


Sounds like your next challange?

We look forward to receiving your application

description_html:
Deine Mission

Als Projektmanager / Projektentwickler (m/w/d) für Agri PV übernimmst du Verantwortung für Projekte an der Schnittstelle von Erneuerbarer Energie, Landwirtschaft und Baurecht.
Du begleitest unsere Agri PV Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur Genehmigung oder schlüsselfertigen Übergabe – mit einem klaren Ziel: nachhaltige Energielösungen Realität werden zu lassen.


Über uns

feld.energy ist mehr als nur ein Unternehmen – wir sind eine Bewegung!
Wir helfen Landwirten und Landeigentümern, Landwirtschaft und Energieerzeugung clever miteinander zu kombinieren. Mit unseren innovativen Agri-Photovoltaik-Lösungen schaffen wir doppelte Flächennutzung – für Lebensmittelproduktion und saubere Energie. So gestalten wir die Energiewende auf dem Land – nachhaltig, wirtschaftlich und zukunftsorientiert.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Als Projektmanager bzw. Projektentwickler (m/w/d) übernimmst du die volle Verantwortung für unsere Agri PV Projekte, ab Vertragsabschluss bis hin zur Baureife.
  • Planung, Steuerung und Priorisierung der Projektmeilensteine gehören zu deinem Alltag. Du behältst Budgets, Aufgaben und Ziele jederzeit im Blick.
  • Im Austausch mit Kommunen, Behörden, Landwirt:innen und externen Partner:innen bringst du Projekte diplomatisch und lösungsorientiert voran.
  • Du begleitest baurechtliche Verfahren und stellst sicher, dass alle Anforderungen transparent und fristgerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • Darüber hinaus entwickelst du Strategien für Akzeptanz und Beteiligung in Gemeinden und der Öffentlichkeit.
  • Du bewertest die Potenziale der Doppelnutzung landwirtschaftlicher Flächen, etwa für Tierhaltung oder Ackerbau unter PV-Modulen,und integrierst diese in die Projektplanung.
  • Mit klarer Kommunikation und Fokus auf Ergebnisse steuerst du fachübergreifende Teams aus Planer:innen, Gutachter:innen, Jurist:innen und Agronom:innen effizient.


Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung, idealerweise in einer verwandten Fachrichtung wie Bauingenieurwesen, Umwelttechnik, Agrarwissenschaften, erneuerbaren Energien oder vergleichbaren Bereichen.
  • Erste Erfahrung in der Projektentwicklung, Bauleitplanung und/oder PV Branche.
  • Erfahrungen im Behörden- und Genehmigungswesen wünschenswert.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte, genaue und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und diplomatisches Geschick im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
  • Mindestens verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind essenziell.


Warum wir?

  • Echte Anteile am Unternehmenserfolg durch Mitarbeiterbeteiligungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit erfolgreichen Serienunternehmern und innovativen Experten.
  • 27 Tage für deine persönliche Erholung.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Feiern der Erfolge.
  • Kostenlose Getränke und frisches Obst im Büro für deinen Energie-Boost.
  • Neueste technische Ausstattung und innovative Software, die deinen Arbeitsalltag erleichtert.
  • Top-Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten im Bereich erneuerbare Energien und nachhaltige Geschäftsführung.
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die auf Nachhaltigkeit, Innovation und Zusammenarbeit setzt.

Gehaltlich bieten wir 45.000 – 60.000€ Jahresgehalt (je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation). Unser Arbeitsmodell ist hybrid mit Bürostandort in München.

Bist du bereit, die Energiewende in der Landwirtschaft mitzugestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Country Operations Lead (m/w/d)

description_html:
Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Padel ein magischer Sport ist – einer, der Menschen durch seine einzigartige Kombination aus Leichtigkeit, Dynamik und sozialer Interaktion begeistert. Padel ist für alle da: von Jung bis Alt, vom Anfänger bis zum Profi – jeder kann an dieser Leidenschaft teilhaben. Es ist mehr als nur ein Spiel; es ist ein Erlebnis, das verbindet, Freude bereitet und Freundschaften schafft.

mitte ist ein Boutique Padel Club, der erstklassige Spielbedingungen und ein stilvolles Umfeld für unsere dynamische, moderne Community bietet. Unsere Clubs kombinieren hochwertige Einrichtung in zentralen innerstädtischen Standorten mit digitaler Innovation und menschlicher Wärme, um Padel zu einem festen Bestandteil des Alltags zu machen – sei es für ein schnelles Spiel oder als „Third Place“ für verschiedenste Erlebnisse.

Was uns besonders macht:

  • Unsere Indoor-Clubs sind so gelegen, dass man sie in unter 15 Minuten erreichen kann – ideal für den urbanen Alltag
  • Unsere vollautomatisierten Systeme sorgen für ein reibungsloses, modernes Spielerlebnis
  • Unsere Community Leader leben Gastfreundschaft und hospitality-like Betreuung und widmen sich voll und ganz der Aufgabe, hervorragende Gastgeber zu sein
  • Unser Interior Design stammt von einem renommierten Boutique-Architekten

Unsere Ambition: Die globale Brand für Premium Padel zu werden.

Aufgaben

Als Country Operations Lead verantwortest du die operative Performance aller Clubs und stellst sicher, dass jedes Mitglied – unabhängig von Standort oder Team – dieselbe außergewöhnliche Customer Experience erlebt. Du sorgst dafür, dass das Operating Model von mitte in jedem Club konsequent umgesetzt wird. Du berichtest an die COO und arbeitest eng mit Central Operations, Commercial, Construction, Brand und People zusammen.

Central Operations definiert und misst den Standard – du verantwortest das Ergebnis im Club, also die konsequente Umsetzung und Performance vor Ort.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Local Operations: Du verantwortest die operative Performance aller Clubs. Gemeinsam mit den Regional Operations Managern stellst du sicher, dass jeder Standort seine Ziele hinsichtlich Umsatz, Profitabilität, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit erreicht.
  • Leadership: Du entwickelst Regional Operations Manager und Club Manager zu starken Führungskräften, baust eine leistungsorientierte Kultur auf und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten sowie konsequente Führung über alle Regionen hinweg.
  • Customer Experience: Du verantwortest die Customer Experience über alle Clubs hinweg und stellst sicher, dass Service, Hospitality, Community und Markenauftritt an jedem Standort den Standards von mitte entsprechen.
  • Operational Execution: Du stellst sicher, dass das Operating Model von mitte in allen Clubs konsequent umgesetzt wird. Standards, Prozesse und Systeme werden nicht nur eingeführt, sondern im operativen Alltag gelebt.
  • Club Growth & Stabilization: Du verantwortest die operative Entwicklung neuer und bestehender Clubs. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Standorte schnell ihre Zielperformance erreichen und bestehende Clubs ihr Potenzial kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.
  • Continuous Improvement: Du identifizierst Best Practices sowie strukturelle Herausforderungen aus den Clubs und sorgst gemeinsam mit Central Operations dafür, dass diese in die Weiterentwicklung des Operating Models, der Systeme und der Prozesse einfließen.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Du arbeitest eng mit Central Operations, Commercial, Brand, Construction, Finance und People zusammen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Initiativen erfolgreich und konsistent in allen Clubs umgesetzt werden.

Das Besondere an dieser Rolle ist, dass…

  • Du verantwortest die operative Performance aller Clubs und führst die gesamte Field Operations Organisation.
  • Du entwickelst Führungskräfte und baust eine High-Performance-Kultur über alle Standorte hinweg auf.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass mitte auch mit mehreren hundert Clubs dieselbe operative Exzellenz und Customer Experience liefert.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der COO / Mitgründerin und den Gründern bei kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Qualifikation

  • 5+ Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Multi-Site-Unternehmen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Führung regional verteilter Operations-Teams.
  • Tiefes Verständnis für die Steuerung operativer Performance anhand relevanter KPIs.
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft und Freude daran, regelmäßig Zeit in den Clubs zu verbringen.
  • Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Coaching- und Kommunikationsstärke.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität kombiniert mit strategischem Denken und hoher Umsetzungsstärke.
  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld klare Prioritäten zu setzen.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil einer Erfolgsgeschichte: Unser Ziel ist klar: Europas größter Padel-Operator zu werden. Du bist von Anfang an dabei – mit der Chance, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und diese Vision aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Zentrales Büro im Herzen Berlins: Ein Ort für produktives Arbeiten und offenen Austausch auf Augenhöhe. Snacks & Getränke stehen selbstverständlich bereit.
  • Modernes Equipment: Du arbeitest mit einem MacBook und allem, was du brauchst, um produktiv zu sein.
  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Foundern zusammen und bekommst aus erster Hand mit, wie Entscheidungen getroffen, Strukturen aufgebaut und Strategien entwickelt und umgesetzt werden.
  • Entlohnung: Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit langfristigen Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • Deine Uniform: Wir statten dich mit unserer exklusiven mitte Teamwear von adidas aus.
  • Sport & Wellbeing: Bei uns bekommst du regelmäßige Padel Matches auf unseren Courts - für deinen körperlichen Ausgleich und dein Wohlbefinden neben dem Arbeitsalltag.

title: Pflichtpraktikum Projektmanagement & Vertrieb / Customer Operations (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at LET IT CLICK GmbH
description_html:
LET IT CLICK ist nicht einfach nur eine Website – wir sind Deutschlands am schnellsten wachsende Plattform für On-Demand-Fotografie mit über 200 Profis im Netzwerk. Gleichzeitig agieren wir als kreative Marketingagentur und pushen Marken sowie unvergessliche Momente auf das nächste Level. Unser Motto: SAVE EVERY MOMENT.

Für den Ausbau unserer Buchungsplattform suchen wir ein Organisationstalent mit Macher-Mentalität: Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen anfragenden Kunden und unserem deutschlandweiten Fotografen-Netzwerk. Du sorgst dafür, dass Shootings von der ersten Anfrage bis zur finalen Bildübergabe reibungslos ablaufen – und bringst Deals aktiv zum Abschluss.

Aufgaben

• Kundenbetreuung & Vertrieb: Eingehende Shooting-Anfragen (Hochzeiten, Anträge, JGAs, Events) bearbeiten, Angebote erstellen, charmant nachhaken und Buchungen abschließen.

• Fotografen-Matching & Koordination: Passende Fotografen aus unserem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk auswählen, Termine abstimmen und Shootings zuverlässig briefen.

• Projektmanagement End-to-End: Den gesamten Workflow begleiten – von der Terminabsprache über die Online-Galerien bis hin zur Weiterleitung der Kundenauswahlen an unser Retusche-Team.

• Kundenkommunikation & Support: Schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen finden bei Terminverschiebungen, Ausfällen oder kurzfristigen Kundenwünschen.

• Plattform- & Prozesspflege: Interne Übersichten, Tabellen und Tools pflegen und wiederkehrende Abläufe aktiv optimieren.

Qualifikation

• Pflichtpraktikum: Du suchst ein mehrmonatiges Pflichtpraktikum im Rahmen deines Studiums oder deiner Ausbildung (z. B. BWL, Medien-/Eventmanagement, Kommunikation o. Ä.).

• Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast Spaß am direkten Kontakt mit Kunden und Dienstleistern (Chat, Mail, Telefon) und triffst immer den richtigen Ton.

• Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Aufträgen den Überblick über Fristen, To-Dos und Rückmeldungen.

• Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Mitdenken und lösungsorientiertes Anpacken.

• Sprachgefühl: Sehr sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Grundkenntnisse in Englisch sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

• Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Kein Kaffeekochen – du steuerst eigenständig echte Kundenprojekte und bist direkt im operativen Plattform-Geschäft dabei.

• 100% Flexibilität: Vollständig remote aus ganz Deutschland arbeiten.

• Startup-Spirit: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für deine eigenen Ideen.

• Starkes Netzwerk: Einblick in moderne B2B-/B2C-Workflows und Kontakt zu hunderten professionellen Fotografen und Kreativen.

Bist du bereit, es klicken zu lassen?

Sende uns deine Kurzbewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf, gewünschtem Zeitraum und dem Nachweis deiner Studienordnung für das Pflichtpraktikum. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Software Configuration Engineer Navy Communication System (m/w/x)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at K-tronik GmbH
description_html:
Projektbeschreibung:

Technologie begeistert Sie? Uns auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Funk- und Kommunikationsbranche suchen wir einen Software Configuration Engineer Navy Communication System (m/w/x) in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennen zu lernen - und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten.

Aufgaben:

  • Du konfigurierst, testest und deployst ein komplexes Naval Communication System für interne Testumgebungen und anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte.
  • Du integrierst Produktzulieferungen und Subsysteme zu einer leistungsfähigen Gesamtlösung in Testanlagen und Kundenumgebungen.
  • Du installierst Schiffskommunikationssysteme auf Testsystemen sowie auf Kundensystemen an unseren Standorten Teisnach oder Kiel und stellst deren zuverlässige Inbetriebnahme sicher.
  • Du zeichnest Log Files auf, analysierst Systemverhalten und identifizierst Fehlerursachen in komplexen Systemlandschaften.
  • Du bearbeitest Defects in Jira, stimmst Dich eng mit der Entwicklung ab und gibst fundiertes technisches Feedback zur Fehlerbehebung.
  • Du wirkst maßgeblich am Aufbau, an der Weiterentwicklung und an der Automatisierung des Testsystems am Standort München mit.

Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein technisches oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation oder Ausbildung
  • Du bringst fundiertes Know-how im RPM Package Management sowie in der Linux- und Windows-Administration mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit CI/CD, Testautomatisierung und modernen Tools wie GitLab, Jenkins, Artifactory, Ansible oder Python.
  • Du besitzt grundlegende Kenntnisse in der IP-Netzwerktechnologie und bist sicher im Umgang mit Servern, Netzwerkswitches sowie komplexen IT- und Kommunikationssystemen.
  • Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur strukturierten Fehleranalyse, kannst klar mit deinen relevanten Stakeholdern kommunizieren und arbeitest gerne im Team.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Benefits:

  • Kollegiales und freundschaftliches Arbeitsklima
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • 30 Urlaubstage und flexible Urlaubsplanung
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events
  • Auszeichnung als Kununu TOP Company
  • Corporate Benefits (Mitarbeiterangebote)
  • Kostenlose Getränke
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • 360° Betreuung: Feedbackgespräche, Karriereplanung, Unterstützung bei Umzug, etc.

description_html:

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.
